title: Temporal Contrastive Transformer for Financial Crime Detection: Self-Supervised Sequence Embeddings via Predictive Contrastive Coding
summary: We introduce the Temporal Contrastive Transformer (TCT), a representation learning framework designed to capture contextual temporal dynamics in sequences of financial transactions. The model is trained using a self-supervised contrastive objective to produce embeddings that encode behavioral patterns over time, with the goal of supporting downstream fraud detection tasks. We evaluate TCT in a realistic setting by using the learned embeddings as input features to a gradient boosting classifier. Experimental results show that embeddings alone achieve meaningful predictive performance (AUC 0.8644), indicating that the model captures non-trivial temporal structure. However, when combined with domain-engineered features, no measurable improvement is observed over the baseline (AUC 0.9205 vs. 0.9245), suggesting that the learned representations largely overlap with existing feature abstractions. These findings position TCT as a promising representation learning approach that captures relevant behavioral signal, while highlighting the challenges of achieving additive value over strong domain features. The results reflect an intermediate stage in the development of temporal representation learning for financial crime detection and motivate further research on model architecture, training objectives, and integration strategies. At this early stage, achieving performance comparable to a strong feature-engineered baseline is itself a meaningful outcome, indicating that learned representations approximate domain-specific features without manual engineering. While not yet production-ready, these results point to a promising direction for reducing reliance on feature engineering in financial crime detection.

title: Teaching Language Models to Forecast Research Success Through Comparative Idea Evaluation
summary: As language models accelerate scientific research by automating hypothesis generation and implementation, a new bottleneck emerges: evaluating and filtering hundreds of AI-generated ideas without exhaustive experimentation. We ask whether LMs can learn to forecast the empirical success of research ideas before any experiments are run. We study comparative empirical forecasting: given a benchmark-specific research goal and two candidate ideas, predict which will achieve better benchmark performance. We construct a dataset of 11,488 idea pairs grounded in objective outcomes from PapersWithCode. While off-the-shelf 8B-parameter models struggle (30% acc.), SFT dramatically boosts performance to 77.1%, outperforming GPT-5 (61.1%). By framing evaluation as a reasoning task via Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), we train models to discover latent reasoning paths, achieving 71.35% acc. with interpretable justifications. Through additional ablations and out-of-distribution tests, we show robustness to surface-level heuristics and transfer to both a cross-domain time-split test set and an independently constructed test set. Our results demonstrate that compute-efficient small language models can serve as effective, objective verifiers, offering a scalable path for autonomous scientific discovery.

title: The Attribution Impossibility: No Feature Ranking Is Faithful, Stable, and Complete Under Collinearity
comments: 66 pages, 12 figures, 305 Lean 4 theorems. Code at https://github.com/DrakeCaraker/dash-impossibility-lean
summary: No feature ranking can be simultaneously faithful, stable, and complete when features are collinear. For collinear pairs, ranking reduces to a coin flip. We prove this impossibility, quantify it for four model classes, resolve it via ensemble averaging (DASH), and machine-verify it with 305 Lean 4 theorems. We characterize the complete attribution design space: exactly two families of methods exist -- faithful-complete methods (unstable, with rankings that flip up to 50% of the time) and ensemble methods like DASH (stable, reporting ties for symmetric features) -- and no method lies outside this dichotomy. The impossibility is quantitative: the attribution ratio diverges as 1/(1-rho^2) for gradient boosting, is infinite for Lasso, and converges for random forests. DASH (Diversified Aggregation of SHAP) is provably Pareto-optimal among unbiased aggregations, achieving the Cramer-Rao variance bound with a tight ensemble size formula. In a survey of 77 public datasets, 68% exhibit attribution instability. Switching to conditional SHAP does not escape the impossibility when features have equal causal effects. The framework includes practical diagnostics -- a Z-test workflow and single-model screening tool -- and has direct consequences for fairness auditing: SHAP-based proxy discrimination audits are provably unreliable under collinearity. The design space theorem, diagnostics, and impossibility are mechanically verified in Lean 4 (305 theorems from 16 axioms, 0 sorry) -- to our knowledge, the first formally verified impossibility in explainable AI.
comment: 66 pages, 12 figures, 305 Lean 4 theorems. Code at https://github.com/DrakeCaraker/dash-impossibility-lean

title: Don't Collapse Your Features: Why CenterLoss Hurts OOD Detection and Multi-Scale Mahalanobis Wins
summary: The ability to detect out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs is fundamental to safe deployment of machine learning systems. Yet, current methods often rely on feature representations that are optimised solely for classification accuracy, neglecting the distinct requirements of epistemic uncertainty. We introduce GOEN (Geometry-Optimised Epistemic Network), a simple pipeline that combines multi-scale features, L2 normalisation, Mahalanobis distance, and a calibration head trained with real hard OOD examples. Through systematic ablation we uncover a counter-intuitive finding: CenterLoss, a popular regulariser for feature compactness, significantly degrades OOD detection performance, reducing average OOD AUROC from 0.9483 to 0.9366 despite improving classification accuracy. The best variant, GOEN-NoCenterLoss, achieves an average OOD AUROC of 0.9483, surpassing all baselines including deep ensembles (0.8827), KNN (0.8967), and ODIN (0.8870) on CIFAR-10 benchmarks, while maintaining competitive in-distribution accuracy. Our results challenge the prevailing assumption that better classification geometry automatically leads to better epistemic uncertainty. Instead, we show that overly tight feature clusters compress inter-class margins and distort the covariance structure needed for effective OOD detection. GOEN is efficient, training in under 20 minutes on a single GPU, and provides a practical blueprint for building AI systems that reliably recognise their own limitations.

title: Double descent for least-squares interpolation on contaminated data: A simulation study
summary: Overparametrized models can exhibit an excellent generalization performance, although they should be prone to overfitting according to classical statistical theory. The discovery of the "double descent", indicating that the generalization error decreases after a certain model complexity has been reached, opened a new line of research. Robust statistics considers statistical estimation on contaminated data, which, due to assumptions that do not hold on real data, let data points appear as outliers w.r.t. the assumed "ideal" distribution, potentially severely distorting any classical estimator. We address the question whether a double descent phenomenon can be observed in a linear regression setting with contaminated training data. We compare the performance of the highly non-robust least-squares interpolation estimator with several robust alternatives. It turns out that large overparametrization indeed allows for a double descent phenomenon, resulting in a very good generalization performance of the least-squares interpolator, surpassing that of the robust alternatives.

title: Requirements Perception Gap across Stakeholders: A Comparative Survey of Aged Care Digital Health Software
summary: We sought to explore and compare the perspectives of three key stakeholder groups: older adults, caregivers (formal health providers and informal caregivers), and digital health software developers on key functional and non-functional requirements. We conducted a survey, designed based on the findings from an existing systematic review, to gather and analyse data related to the three stakeholder groups' (dis)satisfaction with current aged care digital health software and their views on key future aged care software requirements. A mixed-methods survey approach integrated quantitative questionnaire data and qualitative open-ended responses from a total sample of 249, comprised of older adults (103), formal and informal caregivers (41), and software developers (105). Data analysis utilised a mixed methods approach, employing inferential statistics to compare group satisfaction levels and thematic analysis for qualitative open-ended responses. Our analysis reveals a significant "Requirements Gap". Software developers tend to prioritise advanced features and functional requirements, significantly overestimating user satisfaction with core NFRs such as ease of use and responsiveness. Conversely, developers were more critical of existing functional features compared to older adults and caregivers, who prioritised simplicity and reliability over feature density. By combining quantitative and qualitative analysis, we identified where stakeholder priorities align and where they diverge across functional and non-functional requirements in both the current designs they used and the future designs they desire. Our findings present a stakeholder gap analysis that can guide future co-design processes, near-term product decisions, and privacy-by-design recommendations in aged care digital health.

title: HealthCraft: A Reinforcement Learning Safety Environment for Emergency Medicine
comments: 16 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Code, task suite, and Docker bundle: https://github.com/GOATnote-Inc/healthcraft
summary: Frontier language models are being deployed into clinical workflows faster than the infrastructure to evaluate them safely. Static medical-QA benchmarks miss the failure modes that matter in emergency medicine: trajectory-level safety collapse, tool misuse, and capitulation under sustained clinical pressure. We present HealthCraft, the first public reinforcement-learning environment that rewards trajectory-level safety under realistic emergency-medicine conditions, adapted from Corecraft. It is built on a FHIR R4 world state with 14 entity types and 3,987 seed entities, exposes 24 MCP tools, and defines a dual-layer rubric that zeroes reward whenever any safety-critical criterion is violated. We release 195 tasks across six categories, graded against 2,255 binary criteria (515 safety-critical); a post-hoc 10-task negative-class slate extends this to 205 tasks and 2,337 criteria. V8 results on two frontier models show Claude Opus 4.6 at Pass@1 24.8% [21.5-28.4] and GPT-5.4 at 12.6% [10.2-15.6], with safety-failure rates of 27.5% and 34.0%. On multi-step workflows - the closest proxy to real emergency care - performance collapses to near zero (Claude 1.0%, GPT-5.4 0.0%) despite partial competence on individual steps. Six infrastructure bugs fixed between pilots v2 and v8 re-ordered which model "looks stronger," evidence that infrastructure fidelity is part of the measurement. A deterministic LLM-judge overlay bounds evaluator noise, and a 60-run negative-class smoke pilot shows the reward signal is not drop-in training-safe: restraint criteria pass at 0.929 prevalence, a gameability an eval harness can tolerate but a training reward cannot. We scaffold coupling to a Megatron+SGLang+GRPO loop per Corecraft Section 5.2 and leave training-reward ablations as future work. Environment, tasks, rubrics, and harness are released under Apache 2.0.
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Code, task suite, and Docker bundle: https://github.com/GOATnote-Inc/healthcraft

title: Autonomous LLM Agents & CTFs: A Second Look
comments: Accepted at DeMeSSAI Workshop @ IEEE EuroS&P 2026
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly proposed to automate offensive security tasks, with recent studies reporting near human-level success rates in Capture-the-Flag (CTF) challenges. We here revisit these results, providing a second look at these claims. We engineer different agent architectures of increasing complexity and modularity on 30 web-based CTFs challenges spanning 14 vulnerability classes. We instantiate these agents with multiple LLM backbones, and compare them with claude-code, a general-purpose agent that automatically determines its internal architecture. Our evaluation yields three main findings. First, claude-code achieves performance comparable to the engineered architectures (19/30 solved tasks), suggesting that general-purpose agents are strong baselines for offensive security tasks. Second, both our architectures and claude-code struggle in the same challenge categories, revealing persistent barriers that keep current agents below human-level capability. Third, by leveraging our manually designed architectures we can systematically measure the impact of additional components, finding that structured orchestration of specialized roles outperforms monolithic designs, improving run-to-run consistency, and reducing execution costs.
comment: Accepted at DeMeSSAI Workshop @ IEEE EuroS&P 2026

title: Chain Reactions: How Nonce Collisions in ECDSA Compromise Polygon MEV Searchers
summary: ECDSA signatures form the bedrock of blockchain transaction authentication, yet their security critically depends on proper nonce generation. We uncover a critical vulnerability in the Polygon MEV ecosystem: systematic nonce reuse that enables complete private key recovery. Analyzing on-chain data reveals that searchers, driven by the need for sub-second response times in sealed-bid auctions, employ predictable nonce patterns. These patterns create linear relationships between signatures, allowing passive attackers to recover private keys using elementary algebra. We provide a compact linear-system formulation for such attacks, including the dangerous case of cross-wallet nonce collisions, and present concrete evidence of exploitable patterns on Polygon. Our findings demonstrate how protocol-induced latency pressures can lead to catastrophic cryptographic failures in production blockchain systems, where a single implementation error compromises multiple accounts simultaneously.

title: Community-Aware Vertex Ordering for Reference-Based Graph Compression: A Cross-Encoder Empirical Study
comments: 26 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables. Full reproducibility package at https://github.com/jimbotonic/Adjacently.jl. Preprint; comments welcome
summary:
Reference-based graph compression encodes each vertex's neighbor list relative to a recent vertex, exploiting locality to compress large directed graphs. The dominant tool, WebGraph's BVGraph, fixes a single encoding pipeline and relies on a separately chosen vertex ordering -- typically URL-lexicographic or Layered Label Propagation (LLP). The interaction between ordering and encoder is rarely measured.
  We propose a two-stage Leiden+LLP vertex ordering -- global LLP to seed labels, Leiden community detection, then per-cluster LLP on each induced subgraph -- and study how it interacts with reference-based compression. On graphs with poor initial vertex order, reordering saves 0.3 to 5.4 bits per edge on every dataset and encoder we measured. The size of that gain is largely insensitive to the encoder: on four of five weakly ordered datasets, four independently parameterised encoders agree on the Leiden+LLP-vs-plain-LLP gain within roughly +/- 0.04 bpe. On URL-ordered web crawls, where the distributed ordering already encodes locality, adaptive encoders still benefit from reordering, but encoders tuned to URL-induced residual structure (BV-HC, CG at K>1) are mildly hurt by it.
  To quantify how much encoder choice matters once ordering is fixed, we contribute three reference-based encoders -- BG, CS, and CG -- that perform per-vertex cost-optimal selection from up to 28 candidate decompositions. Each is run under its own best-tested ordering. The best of the three improves over BVGraph high-compression by 2-9% on every dataset tested, with the encoder-level gain consistently smaller than the ordering-level gain on weakly ordered datasets. The encoder framework also yields a self-delimiting bitstream that supports low-overhead random access.
comment: 26 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables. Full reproducibility package at https://github.com/jimbotonic/Adjacently.jl. Preprint; comments welcome

title: Conditional Entropy of Heat Diffusion on Temporal Networks
summary: Many complex systems can be modeled by temporal networks, whose organization often evolves through distinct structural phases. Detecting the change points that delimit these phases is both important and challenging. In this work, we extend the conditional entropy of heat diffusion from static graphs to temporal networks and study its properties. We provide an upper bound and explain how discrepancies from it arise from the presence of asymmetric temporal paths. Moreover, we show that this quantity is monotone in time, yielding an information-theoretic analog of the second law of thermodynamics for inhomogeneous diffusion on temporal networks. We then introduce a local version of conditional entropy, designed to probe diffusion over finite temporal windows, and show that it provides an informative signal for change-point detection in continuous-time temporal networks. We evaluate the proposed methodology on synthetic benchmarks, including comparative experiments with existing nonparametric baselines in the snapshot setting, and then apply it to a real-world temporal contact network from a French primary school. Finally, we show how to use detected change points to perform community detection on targeted sub-intervals, improving the quality and interpretability of the clustering results.

title: Predicting Performance of Symbolic and Prompt Programs with Examples
summary: LLM prompting is widely used for naturally stated tasks, yet it is unreliable it may succeed on a few test cases but fail at deployment time. We study performance prediction: given a program, either symbolic (e.g. Python) or a prompt executed on an LLM, and a few in-domain examples, predict its performance on unseen tasks from the same domain. We use a simple coin-flip model, treating each pass/fail program execution as a Bernoulli random variable, whose success probability is the programs unknown performance. In this model, performance depends entirely on: 1) the observed execution outcomes on test cases, and 2) a prior over performances. We compile empirical performance priors from a corpus of diverse programs and tasks, and find that performance for symbolic programs (e.g., Python) are all or nothing, while prompt programs have a diffuse prior with many nearly-correct programs. This difference explains why a few passing tests can certify symbolic programs but not prompt programs. Building on this insight, we develop RAP (Retrieved Approximate Prior), which retrieves similar tasks and prompt programs from an existing corpus to construct a proxy prior, which is then used to predict performance. We show RAP achieves solid performances.

AI.title_translation: 结合示例预测符号程序与提示词程序的性能
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了符号程序（全或无）与LLM提示词程序（分散分布）在性能先验上的本质差异，并提出了一种基于检索近似先验（RAP）的性能预测方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）提示词程序虽然被广泛使用，但其可靠性不高，经常出现“在少数测试用例上成功但在实际部署时失败”的情况。因此，如何利用少量的域内示例，准确预测符号程序（如Python）或LLM提示词程序在未知任务上的性能，是一个亟待解决的关键问题。
AI.method:
1. 采用简单的掷硬币模型（将程序执行的通过/失败视为伯努利随机变量），将性能预测转化为基于观察结果和性能先验的概率估计问题。
2. 从多样化程序和任务的语料库中编译经验性能先验，对比分析符号程序与提示词程序的先验分布特征。
3. 提出RAP（Retrieved Approximate Prior，检索近似先验）方法，通过从现有语料库中检索相似任务和提示词程序来构建代理先验，并以此预测目标程序的性能。
AI.result:
1. 发现符号程序的性能先验呈现“全或无”的特征（要么全对，要么全错），而提示词程序的先验则较为分散，包含许多“近乎正确”的程序。这解释了为什么少数通过的测试能保证符号程序，却无法保证提示词程序的性能。
2. 实验表明，所提出的RAP方法在预测程序性能方面取得了扎实且优秀的效果。
AI.conclusion: 符号程序与提示词程序在性能先验上存在本质差异（前者为“全或无”，后者较为分散），这解释了为什么传统测试方法难以直接评估提示词程序的可靠性。通过利用检索得到的近似先验（RAP），可以有效预测程序在未见任务上的性能。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）提示词广泛用于自然语言描述的任务，但其并不十分可靠——它可能会在少数测试用例上成功，但在部署时失败。我们研究了性能预测问题：给定一个程序（无论是符号程序如Python，还是在LLM上执行的提示词程序）以及少量的域内示例，预测其在来自同一领域的未见任务上的性能。我们采用了一个简单的掷硬币模型，将每次通过/失败的程序执行视为一个伯努利随机变量，其成功概率即为程序未知的性能。在此模型中，性能完全取决于：1）在测试用例上观察到的执行结果，以及2）性能的先验分布。我们从一个包含多样化程序和任务的语料库中编译了经验性能先验，并发现符号程序（例如 Python）的性能呈现“全或无”的特征，而提示词程序则具有分散的先验，其中包含许多近乎正确的程序。这一差异解释了为什么少数通过的测试可以证明符号程序的正确性，却无法证明提示词程序的正确性。基于这一见解，我们开发了 RAP（检索近似先验）方法，该方法从现有语料库中检索相似的任务和提示词程序来构建代理先验，并将其用于预测性能。我们展示了 RAP 取得了扎实的表现。
AI.summary: 本文研究了如何结合少量示例来预测符号程序（如Python）和LLM提示词程序在未见任务上的性能。研究发现，符号程序的性能先验呈“全或无”分布，而提示词程序的性能先验则更为分散，这导致少量的测试通过无法像保证符号程序那样保证提示词程序的可靠性。基于此，作者提出了RAP（检索近似先验）方法，通过检索相似的任务和程序来构建代理先验，从而实现了对程序性能的有效预测。
AI.keywords: 性能预测, 提示词程序, 符号程序, 先验分布, 检索近似先验
AI.comments: 该论文深入探讨了LLM提示词程序与传统符号程序在可靠性验证上的本质区别。通过引入概率先验视角，合理解释了“少量测试通过无法保证提示词程序在部署时成功”的现象，这对于大模型应用落地具有重要指导意义。提出的RAP方法利用检索机制构建代理先验，具有很强的实用价值。其局限性可能在于对现有语料库丰富度以及任务相似性检索准确度的依赖。

title: Harnesses for Inference-Time Alignment over Execution Trajectories
summary: Harness engineering has emerged as an important inference-time technique for large language model (LLM) agents, aiming to improve long-term performance through task decomposition and guided execution. However, more elaborate harnesses are not uniformly better: increasing decomposition or guidance can sometimes improve execution, but can also reduce final task success. We study harness design through the lens of inference-time trajectory alignment. This perspective separates harness into two mechanisms: task decomposition, which structures a task into sub-goals, and guided execution, which reshapes local action distributions during execution. This decomposition allows us to quantify how workflow granularity, retry budgets, and guidance-induced action reweighting shape the performance limits of harness design. It further reveals concrete failure modes, including over-decomposition, over-pruning, and hallucinated execution. We validate these predictions through controlled synthetic experiments and real terminal agent benchmarks. Inspired by the theory, we further show that effective harnesses can be partial: specifying only the initial steps and leaving the remaining execution to agent can achieve higher pass rate than fully structured workflows.

AI.title_translation: 用于执行轨迹上推理时对齐的Harness（操控架构）设计
AI.tldr: 本文通过推理时轨迹对齐视角研究LLM智能体工作流设计，指出过度分解会降低成功率，并证明仅规划初始步骤的“部分Harness”比完全结构化的工作流更有效。
AI.motivation: 在LLM智能体中，Harness工程（通过任务分解和引导执行来提升长期性能）已成为重要的推理时技术。然而，更复杂的Harness并不总是带来更好的效果，增加分解或引导有时反而会降低最终任务的成功率。因此，需要一个系统性的理论框架来理解、量化并优化Harness的设计。
AI.method:
1. 提出推理时轨迹对齐（Inference-Time Trajectory Alignment）视角，将Harness设计解构为两个机制：任务分解（将任务结构化为子目标）和引导执行（在执行过程中重塑局部动作分布）。
2. 在该理论框架下，量化分析了工作流粒度、重试预算和引导引起的动作重加权对性能极限的影响。
3. 通过受控的合成实验（Controlled Synthetic Experiments）和真实的终端智能体基准测试（Terminal Agent Benchmarks）对理论预测进行验证。
AI.result:
1. 揭示并量化了Harness设计的具体失效模式，包括过度分解（over-decomposition）、过度剪枝（over-pruning）和幻觉执行（hallucinated execution）。
2. 实验验证了理论预测，并表明有效的Harness可以是“部分的”（partial）：仅指定初始步骤并允许智能体自行完成剩余执行，其通过率（pass rate）高于完全结构化的工作流。
AI.conclusion: Harness设计并非越复杂越好，过度分解和引导会导致特定的失效模式。通过合理的“部分Harness”设计（仅指定初始步骤，其余留给智能体自主执行），可以实现比完全结构化工作流更高的任务成功率，这为未来LLM智能体的推理时对齐和引导机制设计提供了新的理论与实践方向。
AI.translation: Harness（操控架构）工程已成为大型语言模型（LLM）智能体的一种重要推理时技术，旨在通过任务分解和引导执行来提高长期性能。然而，更复杂的Harness并不总是更好：增加分解或引导有时可以改善执行，但也会降低最终任务的成功率。我们通过推理时轨迹对齐的视角来研究Harness设计。这一视角将Harness分为两个机制：任务分解（将任务结构化为子目标）和引导执行（在执行期间重塑局部动作分布）。这种分解使我们能够量化工作流粒度、重试预算以及引导引起的动作重加权如何塑造Harness设计的性能极限。它进一步揭示了具体的失效模式，包括过度分解、过度剪枝和幻觉执行。我们通过受控的合成实验和真实的终端智能体基准测试验证了这些预测。受该理论的启发，我们进一步表明，有效的Harness可以是部分的：仅指定初始步骤并将剩余的执行留给智能体，可以比完全结构化的工作流实现更高的通过率。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了LLM智能体中Harness（操控/脚手架）的设计原理。作者引入了推理时轨迹对齐的视角，将Harness解构为任务分解与引导执行两个核心机制，量化了它们对智能体性能极限的影响，并指出了过度分解等失效模式。研究表明，仅规划初始步骤的“部分Harness”往往比完全结构化的工作流更为高效。
AI.keywords: LLM智能体, 推理时对齐, Harness设计, 任务分解, 引导执行
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将大模型智能体（LLM Agent）中常用的Harness（如Scaffolding、工作流脚手架）工程抽象为“推理时轨迹对齐”的理论问题，并系统地将其拆解为任务分解和引导执行两个维度。其最重要的发现是“部分Harness”（仅规划初始步骤）在某些情况下优于完全结构化的工作流，这为当前盲目追求复杂Agent工作流（如过度的SOP设计）的趋势提供了清醒的理论反思。局限性在于，该结论在更复杂、多模态或开放域的Agent场景下的泛化性仍有待进一步验证。

title: The Ephemeral Web and the Case for Proactive Archiving
summary: The web is often treated as a durable record of institutional and social life, yet in practice it is fragile, revisable, and frequently ephemeral. Domains change, redesigns erase earlier material, institutions relocate, maintainers graduate, platforms impose silent limits, and periods of political instability can interrupt digital access entirely. This paper argues that archiving should not remain a niche activity practiced by a few specialists at the margins, but should become a proactive part of website maintenance. I motivate this claim through a case study centered on the Pakistan Embassy International School and College Tehran, whose domain, visual identity, leadership, and physical location all changed within a short period after my graduation. In response, I built and deployed a lightweight automated archival system using Python and GitHub Actions to submit pages and media from the site to the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine. The project shows both that archival preservation can be automated with modest infrastructure and that archival systems are themselves vulnerable to interruption, as illustrated by GitHub's automatic disabling of scheduled workflows after repository inactivity. Drawing on personal experience with internet shutdowns in Iran, open-source sustainability lessons from RPI's RCOS, and the operational history of the archiver, I argue that the ephemerality of the web is not an exception but a structural condition. If digital societies wish to preserve institutional memory and public history without leaving preservation to chance, proactive archiving should become a commonplace part of website maintenance.

AI.title_translation: 瞬逝的网页与主动归档的必要性
AI.tldr: 网页具有脆弱和易逝的特性，本文通过一个基于 Python 和 GitHub Actions 的轻量级自动归档系统案例，指出归档系统自身也存在中断风险，并呼吁将主动归档作为网站日常维护的常规部分。
AI.motivation: 尽管网页常被视为持久的社会和机构记录，但实际上它非常脆弱、易被修改且易于消逝（如域名变更、改版抹去旧内容、平台限制等）。为了避免机构记忆和公共历史的丢失，需要将归档从少数专家的边缘活动转变为网站维护的主动组成部分。
AI.method: 作者设计并部署了一个轻量级的自动化归档系统，利用 Python 和 GitHub Actions 自动将目标网站（巴基斯坦驻德黑兰使馆国际学校和学院）的页面和媒体内容提交给互联网档案馆（Internet Archive）的 Wayback Machine。
AI.result: 该项目表明，利用适度的基础设施即可实现自动化的归档保存；同时，它也揭示了归档系统自身同样面临中断风险，例如 GitHub 会在仓库长期处于非活跃状态后自动禁用定时工作流（scheduled workflows）。
AI.conclusion: 网页的瞬逝性不是特例，而是一种结构性状况。如果数字社会希望保存机构记忆和公共历史，而不是让其听天由命，主动归档应当成为网站维护的常态。
AI.translation: 网页通常被视为机构和社交生活的持久记录，但在实际操作中，它其实是脆弱、可修改且往往是瞬逝的。域名会发生变化，重新设计会抹去早期的资料，机构会搬迁，维护者会毕业，平台会施加无形的限制，而政局动荡时期则可能完全中断数字化访问。本文认为，归档不应继续作为少数边缘专家从事的利基活动，而应成为网站维护中主动的一部分。我通过一个以德黑兰巴基斯坦使馆国际学校和学院为中心的案例研究来论证这一观点，该学校的域名、视觉形象、领导层和物理位置在我毕业后不久都发生了变化。为此，我使用 Python 和 GitHub Actions 构建并部署了一个轻量级的自动化归档系统，将该网站的页面和媒体提交到互联网档案馆的 Wayback Machine。该项目表明，通过适度的基础设施即可实现自动化归档保护，同时也展示了归档系统本身也容易受到中断的影响，例如 GitHub 在仓库处于非活跃状态后会自动禁用定时工作流。结合在伊朗遭遇互联网关停的个人经历、来自伦斯勒理工学院开源软件社团（RCOS）的开源可持续性经验以及该归档器的运行历史，我指出网页的瞬逝性并非例外，而是一种结构性状况。如果数字社会希望保存机构记忆和公共历史，而不是让保护听天由命，主动归档就应该成为网站维护的常态。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了网页的脆弱性与瞬逝性，主张将主动归档纳入网站的日常维护中。作者以其母校网站的剧烈变迁为案例，开发并运行了一个基于 Python 和 GitHub Actions 的轻量级自动归档工具，将内容备份至互联网档案馆。通过该实践，作者指出虽然自动化归档技术上可行且成本较低，但归档系统本身也存在脆弱性（如 GitHub 定时任务因闲置被禁用），并以此强调了在数字社会中建立主动归档机制以保存机构记忆和公共历史的重要性。
AI.keywords: 网页瞬逝性, 主动归档, 自动化归档, 互联网档案馆, 网站维护
AI.comments: 本文将宏观的互联网生态脆弱性与微观的个人/机构案例相结合，具有很强的现实意义和人文关怀。其创新点在于通过一个轻量级的 Python + GitHub Actions 实践，不仅证明了主动归档的可行性，还揭示了“归档工具本身也具有脆弱性（如GitHub Actions因闲置被禁用）”这一有趣且常被忽视的痛点。局限性在于案例较为单一，且提出的轻量级自动化方案在面对大规模或高度动态的现代网页时，可能面临扩展性和反爬虫等技术瓶颈。

title: Neural Acceleration for Graph Partitioning
summary: Graph Partitioning is a critical problem in numerous scientific and engineering domains including social network analysis, VLSI design, and many more. Spectral methods are known to produce quality partitions while minimizing edge cuts for a wide range of problems. However, the computational cost associated with the calculation of the Fiedler vector, an eigenvector associated with the second smallest eigenvalue of the graph Laplacian, remains a significant bottleneck due to memory issues and computational costs. In this paper, we present an accelerated approach to spectral bisection partitioning by replacing the traditional eigenvalue calculation with a simple artificial neural network model to approximate the Fiedler vector. We demonstrate that our approach achieves partitioning quality comparable to spectral bisection while significantly reducing the computational overhead, making it more scalable and efficient for large-scale problems

AI.title_translation: 图划分的神经网络加速
AI.tldr: 本文提出利用简单神经网络近似计算Fiedler向量，以替代传统谱双分法中高成本的特征值计算，从而在保持划分质量的同时显著加速大规模图划分。
AI.motivation: 传统的谱图划分方法虽然质量高，但其依赖于计算图拉普拉斯矩阵的Fiedler向量（第二小特征值对应的特征向量），在大规模图上面临严重的内存瓶颈和高昂的计算开销。
AI.method: 提出一种加速的谱双分划分方法，使用一个简单的人工神经网络（ANN）模型来近似逼近Fiedler向量，从而替代传统的、计算成本高昂的特征值求解过程。
AI.result: 该方法在保持与传统谱双分法相当的图划分质量的同时，显著降低了计算开销，在大规模问题上展现出更高的可扩展性和效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入神经网络来近似Fiedler向量，可以有效克服谱图划分的计算瓶颈，为大规模图划分提供了一种兼顾效率与质量的加速途径。
AI.translation: 图划分是社交网络分析、超大规模集成电路（VLSI）设计等众多科学和工程领域中的一个关键问题。已知谱方法在为广泛的问题最小化边割的同时，能产生高质量的划分。然而，由于内存问题和计算成本，与计算Fiedler向量（图拉普拉斯矩阵第二小特征值对应的特征向量）相关的计算开销仍然是一个重大的瓶颈。在本文中，我们提出了一种加速谱双分划分的方法，通过使用一个简单的人工神经网络模型来近似Fiedler向量，从而替代传统的特征值计算。我们表明，我们的方法在显著降低计算开销的同时，实现了与谱双分法相当的划分质量，使其在大规模问题上更具可扩展性和高效性。
AI.summary: 本文针对大规模图划分中谱方法的计算瓶颈问题，提出了一种神经网络加速方案。传统方法在求解拉普拉斯矩阵的Fiedler向量时计算开销巨大，而本文通过引入一个简单的人工神经网络来近似逼近该向量，从而替代了繁重的传统特征值计算。实验表明，该方法在大幅降低计算和内存开销的同时，保持了与谱双分法相当的划分质量，极大地提升了大规模图划分的效率。
AI.keywords: 图划分, 谱双分, Fiedler向量, 神经网络, 计算加速
AI.comments: 该方法巧妙地将神经网络的函数逼近能力引入到传统的谱图理论中，用近似计算替代高成本的特征值求解，对于大规模图处理具有很强的实用价值。不过，摘要未提及神经网络的训练成本以及对不同拓扑结构图的泛化能力，这可能是其应用中的潜在局限。

title: Same Pipeline, Opposite Conclusions: Sample-Surface Effects in Breaking-News Latency
summary: Osborne and Dredze (2014) reported that Twitter was the timeliest social-media source of breaking news, trailing only newswire. Twelve years on, the platform landscape has shifted - Google+ is gone, X replaced Twitter, Bluesky and Threads have appeared - and platform data now flows almost exclusively through commercial social-listening providers that redact key fields. We revisit the question with two sampling designs run through the same downstream pipeline. Sample A draws N = 50 events from the Wikipedia Current Events Portal (WCEP) ranked by article pageviews. Sample B draws N = 109 events from Polymarket prediction markets ranked by USD trading volume, with each event's news moment pinned to the largest 1-hour trade-volume spike. Both samples are pulled from one commercial provider across nine indexed channels. We report three findings. (1) The X-vs-news direction depends on the sample. News leads X by a median of 21.6 min on Sample A (n = 6 paired); the same comparison is tied at -0.02 min on Sample B (n = 16 paired, X earliest in 38%). (2) The channel ecosystem has diversified. Bluesky, Facebook public, and YouTube together account for 24-32% of earliest channel wins; the 2014 "X versus newswire" framing no longer fits. (3) Coverage gaps are structural. Even with U.S.-relevance filtering and a pageview prior, the provider's index returns no on-topic evidence on 24% of randomly-sampled WCEP events. The paper's contribution is the cross-surface design that exposes the sample dependency in (1).

AI.title_translation: 相同的管道，相反的结论：突发新闻延迟中的样本表面效应
AI.tldr: 本研究通过对比两个不同的事件样本，发现社交媒体与新闻媒体在突发新闻时效性上的对比结论高度依赖于样本选择，并指出当前的社交媒体渠道已多元化且存在结构性覆盖漏洞。
AI.motivation: 在社交平台格局剧变（如X取代Twitter、新兴平台涌现、商业数据提供商对关键字段进行脱敏）的背景下，重新评估不同社交媒体和新闻渠道在突发新闻传播中的时效性，并探究样本选择如何影响研究结论。
AI.method: 采用双样本设计的交叉对比方法，使用相同的下游处理管道，从同一商业社交监听提供商的9个索引渠道中提取数据。样本A包含50个来自维基百科每日重要事件门户（WCEP）的事件（按浏览量排序）；样本B包含109个来自Polymarket预测市场的事件（按交易量排序，并以最大1小时交易量飙升点作为新闻发生时刻）。
AI.result: (1) X与新闻媒体的时效性对比取决于样本：在WCEP样本（样本A）中，新闻媒体比X快中位数21.6分钟；而在Polymarket预测市场样本（样本B）中，两者几乎持平（中位数差-0.02分钟，X在38%的情况下最快）。(2) 渠道生态更加多元化：Bluesky、Facebook公开页面和YouTube合计占最先发布渠道的24-32%。(3) 存在结构性覆盖缺口：即使经过筛选，数据提供商的索引在24%的随机WCEP事件中也未能返回任何相关证据。
AI.conclusion: 突发新闻的时效性结论具有高度的样本依赖性，传统的“X对决新闻通讯社”的单一对比框架已不再适用。同时，现代社交媒体生态已高度多元化，且商业数据源中存在不可忽视的结构性内容覆盖缺失。
AI.translation: Osborne 和 Dredze (2014) 曾报道称，Twitter 是时效性最强的突发新闻社交媒体来源，仅次于新闻通讯社。十二年过去了，平台格局发生了变化——Google+ 消失了，X 取代了 Twitter，Bluesky 和 Threads 出现了，而且平台数据现在几乎完全通过对关键字段进行脱敏的商业社交监听提供商进行流动。我们通过在相同的下游管道中运行两种样本设计来重新审视这个问题。样本 A 从维基百科每日重要事件门户（WCEP）中抽取 N = 50 个事件，并按文章页面浏览量进行排序。样本 B 从 Polymarket 预测市场中抽取 N = 109 个事件，并按美元交易量排序，每个事件的新闻时刻被定位在最大的 1 小时交易量激增点。这两个样本均来自同一个商业提供商的九个索引渠道。我们报告了三个发现：(1) X 与新闻的对比方向取决于样本。在样本 A 上，新闻领先 X 的中位数为 21.6 分钟（n = 6 对）；在样本 B 上，相同的对比持平于 -0.02 分钟（n = 16 对，X 在 38% 中最早）。(2) 渠道生态系统已经多元化。Bluesky、Facebook 公开页面和 YouTube 共同占最早渠道获胜的 24-32%；2014 年的“X 对决新闻通讯社”框架已不再适用。(3) 覆盖范围缺口是结构性的。即使进行了美国相关性过滤和页面浏览量先验，该提供商的索引在 24% 的随机抽样 WCEP 事件中也没有返回任何主题证据。本文的贡献在于揭示了 (1) 中样本依赖性的跨表面设计。
AI.summary: 本文重新评估了现代社交媒体和新闻渠道在突发新闻传播中的时效性。研究人员使用相同的分析管道，对比了来自维基百科和预测市场的两个不同事件样本。结果表明，关于“社交平台X与新闻媒体谁更快”的结论完全取决于样本的选择。此外，研究还指出突发新闻渠道已呈现多元化趋势，且商业数据源存在严重的结构性覆盖缺失。
AI.keywords: 突发新闻时效性, 样本依赖性, 社交媒体生态, 预测市场, 媒体研究
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于采用“跨表面”样本设计，直接揭示了突发新闻时效性研究中严重的样本依赖性问题（即使用不同的基准事件样本会得出完全相反的结论），这对社交媒体分析和计算传播学的方法论具有重要警示意义。其局限性在于样本量较小（N=50和N=109），且完全依赖于单一商业社交监听提供商的数据索引，可能存在特定平台的过滤偏差。

title: A Reproducible Log-Driven AutoML Framework for Interpretable Pipeline Optimization in Healthcare Risk Prediction
summary: Accurate and reproducible disease risk prediction remains challenging due to heterogeneous features, limited samples, and severe class imbalance. This study introduces yvsoucom-iterkit, a deterministic and log-driven automated machine learning framework that formulates pipeline optimization as a fully reproducible, configuration-level system. Each pipeline is encoded as a traceable log entity, enabling analysis of component attribution, interactions, similarity, and cross-seed robustness. Experiments on the Pima Indians Diabetes and Stroke datasets across more than 18,000 pipeline configurations reveal a structured and partially redundant search space, where performance is governed by a small subset of interacting components. Random Forest importance analysis identifies augmentation (0.454), model choice (0.198), and imbalance handling (0.101) as key drivers on Pima, while imbalance handling dominates Stroke (0.406). Component similarity analysis shows strong redundancy, with feature selection variants (biMax-biMean) exhibiting low RMS distance (0.0252), mixup closely matching no augmentation (0.0279), and TomekLinks aligning with no imbalance handling (0.0325), whereas Gaussian noise shows greater divergence from no augmentation (0.10). The framework achieves strong and stable performance using ensemble models (Weighted-F1 0.89, Macro-F1 0.88 on Pima; Weighted-F1 0.94 on Stroke), while Macro-F1 remains lower on Stroke (0.67) due to class imbalance. Cross-seed analysis reveals a performance-robustness trade-off, with ensembles showing lower variability (0.023-0.026) than SVM. These results indicate that effective AutoML optimization can focus on a reduced set of high-impact components.

AI.title_translation: 面向医疗风险预测中可解释流水线优化的可复现日志驱动AutoML框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可追溯、可复现的日志驱动AutoML框架，通过分析1.8万个流水线配置，揭示了医疗风险预测中搜索空间的冗余性以及关键组件对性能和鲁棒性的影响。
AI.motivation: 在医疗疾病风险预测任务中，由于特征异构、样本量有限以及严重的类别不平衡等问题，构建准确且具有高度可复现性的预测流水线仍然面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 yvsoucom-iterkit 的确定性、日志驱动型自动机器学习（AutoML）框架。该框架将流水线优化构建为一个完全可复现的配置级系统，将每个机器学习流水线编码为可追溯的日志实体，从而能够对组件归因、组件交互、相似性以及跨种子鲁棒性进行深入分析。
AI.result:
在Pima和Stroke数据集上对超过18,000个流水线配置进行了评估。结果表明：
1. 搜索空间存在强冗余性，性能由少数关键组件主导（Pima上关键驱动为数据增强、模型选择和不平衡处理；Stroke上不平衡处理占主导）。
2. 组件相似性分析证实了冗余，例如TomekLinks与“不处理不平衡”高度相似（RMS距离0.0325），而高斯噪声与“无增强”差异较大（0.10）。
3. 集成模型取得了强大且稳定的性能（Pima上Weighted-F1 0.89，Stroke上Weighted-F1 0.94），且跨种子变异性（0.023-0.026）显著低于SVM，体现了性能与鲁棒性的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 有效的AutoML优化不需要盲目搜索整个空间，而是可以专注于由数据增强、模型选择和不平衡处理等高影响力组件组成的精简子集，同时在模型选择中需要权衡性能与鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 由于异构特征、有限样本和严重的类别不平衡，准确且可复现的疾病风险预测仍然具有挑战性。本研究引入了 yvsoucom-iterkit，这是一个确定性的、日志驱动的自动机器学习（AutoML）框架，它将流水线（pipeline）优化构建为一个完全可复现的配置级系统。每个流水线都被编码为一个可追溯的日志实体，从而能够分析组件归因、组件交互、相似性以及跨种子的鲁棒性。在 Pima 印第安人糖尿病和脑卒中（Stroke）数据集上针对超过 18,000 个流水线配置进行的实验表明，搜索空间具有结构化且部分冗余的特征，其中性能由一小部分相互作用的组件所主导。随机森林重要性分析表明，数据增强（0.454）、模型选择（0.198）和不平衡处理（0.101）是 Pima 数据集上的关键驱动因素，而不平衡处理在 Stroke 数据集上占主导地位（0.406）。组件相似性分析显示出极强的冗余性，其中特征选择变体（biMax-biMean）表现出较低的均方根（RMS）距离（0.0252），mixup 与无增强高度匹配（0.0279），TomekLinks 与无不平衡处理相一致（0.0325），而高斯噪声与无增强的分歧较大（0.10）。该框架利用集成模型实现了强大且稳定的性能（Pima 上的 Weighted-F1 为 0.89，Macro-F1 为 0.88；Stroke 上的 Weighted-F1 为 0.94），而由于类别不平衡，Stroke 上的 Macro-F1 仍然较低（0.67）。跨种子分析揭示了性能与鲁棒性之间的权衡，集成模型显示出比 SVM 更低的变异性（0.023-0.026）。这些结果表明，有效的 AutoML 优化可以专注于减少的高影响力组件子集。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 yvsoucom-iterkit 的确定性、日志驱动型AutoML框架，旨在解决医疗风险预测中的可复现性和可解释性难题。该框架将流水线优化过程转化为可追溯的日志实体。通过在两个医疗数据集上对1.8万个配置进行的大规模实验，揭示了搜索空间的冗余性，量化了数据增强、模型选择和不平衡处理等组件对性能的贡献，并验证了集成模型在提升预测性能和鲁棒性方面的优越性。
AI.keywords: 自动机器学习 (AutoML), 医疗风险预测, 流水线优化, 可复现性, 可解释性
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：将机器学习流水线（pipeline）编码为可追溯的日志实体，从而实现完全可复现且可解释的配置级分析，这一设计思路在AutoML领域具有很好的新颖性。
2. 重要性：针对医疗风险预测中面临的数据异构、样本有限和类别不平衡等实际痛点，提供了系统性的组件贡献度分析，有助于医疗AI从业者理解哪些步骤（如数据增强、不平衡处理）最关键。
3. 局限性：实验仅基于Pima Diabetes和Stroke两个相对较小的数据集，未来需要更广泛、更大规模的临床数据集来验证该框架和组件冗余性结论的普适性。

title: Contract Based Verification of Non-functional Requirements for Embedded Automotive C Code
summary: Code contracts provide a robust way to specify functional requirements of safety-critical software in embedded systems. For example, the ANSI/ISO C Specification Language (ACSL) can be used to specify the functional behavior of C code that is then formally verified by the Frama-C framework's Wp plugin. However, non-functional requirements, such as restrictions on control flow and data flow, are also important for embedded systems safety. Untrusted code developed by subcontractors, junior developers, or generated by large language models, can be verified by Wp but may nevertheless call unsafe functions or use uninitialized program variables. To address this problem, we constructed a set of general rules concerning non-functional requirements of C code in safety-critical embedded systems. Our rules are orthogonal to popular C rulesets such as MISRA-C and center on modules and their interaction through interfaces. To enable checking our rules, we propose an interface specification contract language for C modules. We implemented a checker for our rules as a Frama-C plugin, which takes as input a C module and its contract and checks control flow and data flow properties, ensuring, e.g., that only permitted functions are called by the module. We integrated our checker in a toolchain to enable specification and verification of module contracts and ACSL contracts for untrusted code. We report on two case studies on safety-critical C code using software in Scania trucks, where we defined module contracts and ACSL function contracts based on informal system requirements and verified them using our toolchain.

AI.title_translation: 基于合同的嵌入式汽车C代码非功能性需求验证
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对嵌入式汽车C代码非功能性需求的接口合同语言及Frama-C验证工具链，并在斯堪尼亚卡车软件中成功验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 虽然现有的ACSL和Frama-C等工具能有效验证C代码的功能性需求，但由初级开发人员、分包商或大语言模型（LLM）生成的不可信代码，即便通过了功能验证，仍可能存在调用不安全函数、使用未初始化变量等违反非功能性需求的安全隐患。因此，需要一种方法来验证这些非功能性限制。
AI.method:
1. 构建了一套针对C代码非功能性需求的通用规则，重点关注模块及其接口交互；
2. 提出了一种用于C模块的接口规范合同语言；
3. 开发了一个Frama-C插件作为规则检查器，用于检测控制流和数据流属性；
4. 将该检查器集成到工具链中，支持对不可信代码的模块合同和ACSL合同进行联合验证。
AI.result: 成功开发了Frama-C插件及完整的验证工具链。在斯堪尼亚（Scania）重型卡车的两个安全关键C代码案例研究中，基于非正式系统需求定义了模块合同和ACSL函数合同，并利用该工具链成功完成了验证。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于合同的验证方法和工具链能够有效补充传统功能验证的不足，成功验证了汽车嵌入式安全关键代码中的控制流和数据流等非功能性需求。
AI.translation: 代码合同（Code contracts）提供了一种鲁棒的方法来指定嵌入式系统中安全关键软件的功能需求。例如，ANSI/ISO C规范语言（ACSL）可用于指定C代码的功能行为，然后通过Frama-C框架的Wp插件进行形式化验证。然而，非功能性需求（例如对控制流和数据流的限制）对于嵌入式系统的安全也同样重要。由分包商、初级开发人员或大语言模型（LLM）生成的不可信代码，虽然可以通过Wp插件的验证，但仍可能调用不安全的函数或使用未初始化的程序变量。为了解决这个问题，我们构建了一套关于安全关键嵌入式系统中C代码非功能性需求的通用规则。我们的规则与MISRA-C等流行的C规则集是正交的（互不重叠），并以模块及其通过接口的交互为中心。为了能够检查我们的规则，我们提出了一种用于C模块的接口规范合同语言。我们将规则检查器实现为一个Frama-C插件，它将C模块及其合同作为输入，并检查控制流和数据流属性，例如确保模块仅调用允许的函数。我们将检查器集成到一个工具链中，以便对不可信代码进行模块合同和ACSL合同的规范与验证。我们报告了两个在斯堪尼亚（Scania）卡车软件中使用安全关键C代码的案例研究，其中我们根据非正式的系统需求定义了模块合同和ACSL函数合同，并使用我们的工具链对其进行了验证。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对汽车嵌入式C代码非功能性需求（如控制流和数据流约束）的验证方法。作者设计了一种接口规范合同语言，并开发了相应的Frama-C插件和工具链。该方法旨在确保由第三方或AI生成的不可信代码在满足功能需求的同时，也符合非功能性安全规则。通过在斯堪尼亚卡车控制软件上的两个案例研究，验证了该工具链在实际安全关键系统中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 代码合同, 非功能性需求, Frama-C, 嵌入式系统, 静态分析
AI.comments: 本研究的创新之处在于将“合同（Contracts）”的概念从传统的功能性属性验证扩展到了非功能性属性（控制流和数据流限制），这对于由大语言模型（LLM）或外包人员生成的不可信代码的安全审查非常实用。其局限性可能在于非正式需求到形式化合同的转化仍需要人工介入，且规则集对更复杂非功能属性（如时序、资源消耗）的覆盖程度有限。

title: Articulate but Wrong: Self-Review Failures in LLM-Based Code Modernization
comments: 11 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Corpus, oracle, output extractor, prompts, harness, self-review probe, and all 1,980 + 1,979 raw model outputs released as supplementary material at https://zenodo.org/records/20300861
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used to migrate legacy code to modern stacks. We ask a deceptively simple question: when an LLM modernizes legacy code, can the same model be relied upon to recognize when its own output silently changes observable behavior? We run 1,980 real modernization calls across 11 production LLMs from 7 distinct families on a balanced 60-snippet legacy-Python-2 corpus, evaluate every output with a type-strict behavioral oracle, and then ask each model to judge whether its own output preserves behavior. We report four findings. (1) Semantic-preservation drift is prevalent and sharply separable from a cleanly-controlled baseline: semantic-trap snippets drift in 39.7% of attempts versus 7.0% on benign-control code that requires no real modernization (+32.7 percentage points; n=660 each). (2) Drift concentrates on specific snippets that fail across models: pairwise model agreement on which snippets are hard is high (mean Pearson r=0.52), and a small core of numeric-semantics snippets fails for nearly every model and every prompt phrasing. (3) Self-review by the producing model is not a reliable safety net: across all semantic drift cases, 31.7% are silently endorsed by the same model that produced them (83/262), and the per-model self-miss rate is strongly bimodal -- ranging from 0% on five models to 100% on one widely deployed model -- with several models explicitly articulating the very Py2/Py3 semantic distinction that broke their output, then declaring behavior preserved. (4) Drift rate is non-monotone in model capability and price: per-model rates range 5.6%-46.7% and do not track model capability cleanly, indicating the failure is task-structural rather than driven by model scale. All code, prompts, the 60-snippet corpus, the behavioral oracle, the output extractor, and the raw model outputs are released.
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Corpus, oracle, output extractor, prompts, harness, self-review probe, and all 1,980 + 1,979 raw model outputs released as supplementary material at https://zenodo.org/records/20300861

AI.title_translation: 能言善辩但错误：基于LLM的代码现代化中的自我审查失败
AI.tldr: 研究表明，在将代码现代化的任务中，LLM无法可靠地通过自我审查发现自己输出中的语义错误；即使模型能正确解释导致错误的语言差异，仍有超过30%的语义漂移被模型自身判定为“行为已保持”。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）被越来越多地用于将遗留代码迁移到现代技术栈，研究人员希望探究：当LLM在现代化遗留代码时，是否可以依赖同一个模型来识别其自身的输出何时默默改变了代码的可观测行为。
AI.method: 研究人员在包含60个遗留Python 2代码片段的平衡语料库上，对来自7个不同家族的11个商用LLM进行了1,980次真实的代码现代化调用。接着，利用一个类型严格的行为预言机（behavioral oracle）评估每个输出，然后要求每个模型自己判断其输出是否保持了原代码的可观测行为。
AI.result: (1) 语义保持漂移普遍存在：在语义陷阱代码段中，39.7%的尝试发生了漂移，而无需真正现代化的良性对照组仅为7.0%。(2) 漂移高度集中：不同模型在哪些代码段属于难题上表现出高度一致性（平均Pearson r=0.52），且一小部分数值语义片段在几乎所有模型和提示词下均失败。(3) 自我审查不可靠：在所有发生语义漂移的案例中，有31.7%被生成它们的同一模型默认许可。部分模型甚至在清晰阐述了导致错误的Py2/Py3语义差异后，仍宣称行为已保持。(4) 漂移率与模型能力和价格呈非单调关系（范围在5.6%至46.7%之间），表明该失败并非由模型规模决定。
AI.conclusion: LLM的自我审查并不能作为代码现代化过程中的可靠安全网。自我审查的失效是任务结构性的，而非仅由模型规模或能力不足驱动。在实际的代码现代化应用中，不能盲目信任模型的自我评估。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地被用于将遗留代码迁移到现代技术栈中。我们提出了一个看似简单的问题：当LLM对遗留代码进行现代化改造时，是否可以依赖同一个模型来识别其自身的输出何时默默改变了可观测的行为？我们在一个包含60个遗留Python-2代码片段的平衡语料库上，对来自7个不同家族的11个生产级LLM运行了1,980次真实的现代化调用，使用类型严格的行为预言机评估每个输出，然后要求每个模型判断其自身的输出是否保持了行为。我们报告了四个发现：（1）语义保持漂移普遍存在，且与控制良好的基线有明显区别：语义陷阱代码片段在39.7%的尝试中发生漂移，而无需真正现代化的良性对照代码中这一比例为7.0%（高出32.7个百分点；各n=660）。（2）漂移集中在特定代码片段上，这些片段在不同模型中均告失败：模型间关于哪些片段是困难的双边一致性很高（平均Pearson r=0.52），并且一小部分核心数值语义代码片段在几乎每个模型和每个提示词表述下都会失败。（3）生产模型的自我审查并不是一个可靠的安全网：在所有语义漂移案例中，有31.7%（83/262）被生产它们的同一模型默认认可，且每个模型的自我遗漏率呈强烈的双峰分布——从五个模型的0%到一个被广泛部署的模型上的100%不等——有几个模型甚至明确阐述了破坏其输出的Py2/Py3语义差异，然后宣称其行为得到了保持。（4）漂移率与模型能力和价格呈非单调关系：每个模型的漂移率在5.6%-46.7%之间，且并不清晰地对应模型能力，这表明该失败是任务结构性的，而非由模型规模驱动。所有代码、提示词、60个代码片段语料库、行为预言机、输出提取器和原始模型输出均已发布。
AI.summary: 本文系统评估了11个主流生产级LLM在将Python 2代码迁移到Python 3时的自我审查能力。通过1,980次实验，研究发现LLM在代码现代化过程中经常默默改变代码的语义（即产生语义漂移），且模型自身无法可靠地识别这些变化（31.7%的漂移被模型自我默许）。甚至存在模型能正确说出导致差异的语言特性却仍判定行为一致的现象。研究表明，自我审查不能作为代码迁移的安全保障，且这种失效是由任务结构决定的。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 代码现代化, 自我审查失败, 语义漂移, 代码迁移
AI.comments: 本文深入揭示了LLM在代码现代化任务中“自我审查”（Self-Review）机制的严重局限性。其创新之处在于通过严谨的实验设计（使用平衡语料库和行为预言机）发现并命名了“能言善辩但犯错（articulate but wrong）”这一现象——即LLM即使能够正确解释导致代码行为改变的语言差异（如Py2/Py3的语义区别），却依然会错误地判断其输出保持了原行为。这一发现具有重要的警示意义，挑战了当前学术界和工业界对“LLM自我纠错”能力的盲目乐观，表明在关键的代码迁移任务中，外部的、严格的测试框架（如行为预言机）依然不可或缺。

title: Academic Text-to-Music Grand Challenge: Datasets, Baselines, and Evaluation Methods
comments: Accepted to IEEE ICME 2026 Grand Challenge Paper
summary: This paper presents an overview and the technical framework of the ICME 2026 Grand Challenge on Academic Text-to-Music Generation (ATTM). Despite the rapid progress in text-to-music generation (TTM) systems, the field is currently dominated by models trained on massive proprietary datasets with industrial-scale computational resources, creating a significant barrier for academic research. To address this, the ATTM Challenge establishes a fair-play benchmark that requires participants to train generative models strictly from scratch using a standardized, CC-licensed subset of the MTG-Jamendo dataset containing only instrumental music. The challenge is divided into two tracks: the Efficiency Track (limited to 500M parameters) and the Performance Track (no parameter limit). Submissions are evaluated through a multi-stage process involving objective metrics, including Frechet Audio Distance, CLAP score, and a novel Concept Coverage Score (CCS), followed by a subjective listening test. By providing open-source baselines, preprocessing pipelines, reference captions, and public evaluation code for computing FAD and CLAP, this challenge aims to facilitate and promote TTM research in academic contexts.
comment: Accepted to IEEE ICME 2026 Grand Challenge Paper

AI.title_translation: 学术文本生成音乐大挑战赛：数据集、基准与评估方法
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ICME 2026学术文本生成音乐（ATTM）挑战赛，该比赛通过提供标准化开源数据集、基准和多阶段评估方法，旨在为学术界建立一个公平的文本生成音乐研究基准。
AI.motivation: 尽管文本生成音乐（TTM）系统发展迅速，但该领域目前被使用海量私有数据集和工业级计算资源训练的模型所主导，这给学术研究带来了巨大的障碍。为了打破这一壁垒，需要为学术界建立一个公平竞争的基准。
AI.method:
1. 设立ATTM挑战赛，要求参赛者使用标准化的、仅包含器乐的CC许可MTG-Jamendo数据集子集，严格从头开始训练生成模型。
2. 划分两个赛道：效率赛道（参数量限制在500M以内）和性能赛道（无参数限制）。
3. 采用多阶段评估流程：客观指标（包括弗雷歇音频距离FAD、CLAP分数及新型概念覆盖分数CCS）与主观听力测试相结合。
4. 提供开源基准（Baselines）、预处理管线、参考字幕以及用于计算FAD和CLAP的公共评估代码。
AI.result: 摘要中未提及具体的参赛或比赛结果，但该挑战赛成功构建并发布了包含开源基准、预处理管线、参考字幕以及用于计算FAD和CLAP的公共评估代码的技术框架，为学术研究提供了基础支持。
AI.conclusion: 本挑战赛通过建立公平的基准、提供开源资源和多阶段评估方法，旨在降低学术界研究门槛，促进和推动学术背景下的文本生成音乐（TTM）研究。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了ICME 2026学术文本生成音乐（ATTM）大挑战赛的概述和技术框架。尽管文本生成音乐（TTM）系统取得了快速进展，但目前该领域主要由在海量专有数据集上使用工业级计算资源训练的模型所主导，这给学术研究带来了巨大的障碍。为了解决这一问题，ATTM挑战赛建立了一个公平竞争的基准，要求参赛者严格使用标准化的、仅包含器乐的MTG-Jamendo数据集的CC授权子集，从头开始训练生成模型。该挑战赛分为两个赛道：效率赛道（限制在5亿参数以内）和性能赛道（无参数限制）。参赛作品通过一个多阶段过程进行评估，包括客观指标（如弗雷歇音频距离FAD、CLAP分数和一种新型的概念覆盖分数CCS），随后进行主观听力测试。通过提供开源基准、预处理管线、参考字幕以及用于计算FAD和CLAP的公共评估代码，本挑战赛旨在促进和推动学术背景下的TTM研究。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了ICME 2026学术文本生成音乐（ATTM）大挑战赛的整体框架。为了解决学术界在文本生成音乐（TTM）研究中面临的数据和算力壁垒，该挑战赛提供了一个基于标准化开源纯器乐数据集的公平竞争平台。挑战赛分为效率和性能两个赛道，并采用结合客观指标（FAD、CLAP及新型CCS分数）与主观听力测试的多阶段评估方法。同时，官方提供了开源基准和评估工具，以促进学术界在TTM领域的研究。
AI.keywords: 文本生成音乐, 学术挑战赛, 基准测试, 评估方法, 开源资源
AI.comments:
1. 重要性：该挑战赛旨在打破工业界因垄断海量私有数据和计算资源而对文本生成音乐（TTM）领域造成的壁垒，为学术界提供了一个公平对比的竞技平台，具有很高的学术价值和现实意义。
2. 创新性：评估体系设计合理，不仅结合了FAD和CLAP等传统客观指标，还引入了新型的概念覆盖分数（CCS），并辅以主观听力测试，确保了评估的全面性。
3. 局限性：由于数据集仅限于MTG-Jamendo的纯器乐（instrumental）子集，该挑战赛无法评估和促进包含人声（vocal）的文本生成音乐研究。

title: DualOptim+: Bridging Shared and Decoupled Optimizer States for Better Machine Unlearning in Large Language Models
summary: We propose DualOptim+, a novel optimization framework for improving machine unlearning in large language models. It introduces a base state to capture common representations shared by forgetting and retaining objectives and delta states to preserve objective-specific residuals. This architecture allows the optimizer to adaptively bridge shared and decoupled states based on the directional conflict between forgetting and retaining gradients. We further introduce DualOptim+ 8bit, a quantized variant that reduces memory overhead without compromising performance. Extensive experiments across fictitious and real-world unlearning, safety alignment, and multi-task learning tasks demonstrate that DualOptim+ consistently achieves a superior trade-off between different objectives. Codes are available at https://github.com/CityU-MLO/DualOptimPlus.

AI.title_translation: DualOptim+: 桥接共享与解耦优化器状态以实现大语言模型中更好的机器遗忘
AI.tldr: 提出DualOptim+框架，通过引入共享基础状态和解耦增量状态，并根据梯度冲突自适应桥接它们，显著提升了大语言模型的机器遗忘效果，同时提供低显存的8bit版本。
AI.motivation: 在大语言模型的机器遗忘过程中，需要同时处理“遗忘特定信息”和“保留通用知识”这两个相互冲突的目标。传统的优化方法难以在两者之间取得完美的平衡，因此需要一种能自适应协调冲突目标的优化器设计。
AI.method:
1. 引入基础状态（base state）捕获遗忘和保留目标共享的通用表示。
2. 引入增量状态（delta states）保存特定目标的残差。
3. 根据遗忘和保留梯度之间的方向冲突，自适应地桥接共享状态和解耦状态。
4. 提出DualOptim+ 8bit量化变体，以在不降低性能的前提下减少内存开销。
AI.result: 在虚构和真实世界的遗忘、安全对齐以及多任务学习任务上的广泛实验表明，DualOptim+始终能在不同的目标之间取得更优的权衡，且其8bit量化版本在降低内存开销的同时保持了优异的性能。
AI.conclusion: DualOptim+通过创新性地结合共享与解耦的优化器状态，成功解决了大语言模型机器遗忘中不同目标相互冲突的难题，是一种高效且实用的优化框架。
AI.translation: 我们提出了 DualOptim+，这是一个旨在改善大型语言模型中机器遗忘的新型优化框架。它引入了一个基础状态（base state）来捕获遗忘和保留目标所共享的通用表示，并引入了增量状态（delta states）来保存特定目标的残差。该架构允许优化器根据遗忘梯度和保留梯度之间的方向冲突，自适应地桥接共享状态和解耦状态。我们还进一步引入了 DualOptim+ 8bit，这是一种量化变体，它在不损害性能的情况下减少了内存开销。在虚构和真实世界的遗忘、安全对齐以及多任务学习任务上的广泛实验表明，DualOptim+ 在不同目标之间始终能取得更优的权衡。代码可在 https://github.com/CityU-MLO/DualOptimPlus 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DualOptim+，一个用于改善大语言模型机器遗忘的新型优化框架。该框架通过“基础状态”捕获共享表示，通过“增量状态”保留目标特有残差，并基于梯度冲突自适应桥接二者。此外，还推出了低显存的8bit量化版本。实验表明，该方法在遗忘和保留目标之间实现了更佳的权衡。
AI.keywords: 机器遗忘, 大语言模型, 优化器状态, 多目标优化, 梯度冲突
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：提出了一种新颖的优化器设计，通过将状态拆分为共享的“基础状态”和解耦的“增量状态”，并根据梯度方向冲突自适应桥接，为解决机器遗忘中的多目标冲突提供了新思路。
2. 重要性：机器遗忘对于大语言模型的隐私保护和安全对齐至关重要，该方法在“遗忘”和“保留”两个相互冲突的指标之间取得了更好的权衡，具有很高的实用价值。
3. 局限性：摘要中未详细说明双优化器状态带来的额外计算和存储管理开销，且在极端或超大规模模型上的扩展性有待进一步验证（尽管提出了8bit量化版本）。

title: Detecting Synthetic Political Narratives in Cross-Platform Social Media Discourse
summary:
The proliferation of large language models has introduced a new paradigm of synthetic political communication in which narratives may be generated, semantically coordinated, and strategically disseminated across platforms at scale. We present a cross-platform framework for detecting synthetic political narratives using four coordination signals -- lexical diversity D(C), temporal burstiness B(C), rhetorical repetition R(C), and semantic homogenization H(C) -- combined into a Synthetic Narrative Coordination Score SNC(C).
  We apply the framework to a corpus of 353,223 records spanning six geopolitical event windows collected from six Telegram channels and nine Reddit communities (2023--2026). Results show that IntelSlava exhibits the lowest lexical diversity (MATTR 0.52--0.54), the highest burstiness (B=+0.48 to +0.73), and the highest rhetorical overlap with peer channels (Jaccard 0.12), ranking first in the composite SNC(C) on four of six event windows (SNC 0.45--0.60). Rybar ranks last on all windows despite its high semantic homogenization, because its Russian-language output yields high lexical diversity and near-zero rhetorical Jaccard with English-language channels -- demonstrating that no single indicator is sufficient for coordination detection. Multi-dimensional SNC(C) scoring provides a more robust and interpretable signal than any individual metric.

AI.title_translation: 跨平台社交媒体言论中合成政治叙事的检测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合词汇、时间、修辞和语义等多维度指标的评分系统（SNC），用于更稳健地检测跨社交媒体平台的合成政治叙事协同传播。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的激增使得在大规模跨平台上自动生成、语义协调和战略性传播合成政治叙事成为可能，这给传统的舆情监管和虚假信息检测带来了全新挑战。
AI.method: 提出一个跨平台检测框架，通过结合词汇多样性 D(C)、时间突发性 B(C)、修辞重复性 R(C) 和语义同质性 H(C) 四个协调信号，构建了合成叙事协调得分 SNC(C)，并在包含353,223条记录的跨平台数据集（涵盖Telegram和Reddit）上进行了应用和验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，IntelSlava在多个事件窗口中表现出最低的词汇多样性、最高的突发性和最高的修辞重叠，在SNC综合得分中位列第一。而Rybar虽然语义同质性高，但由于使用俄语输出，导致词汇多样性高且与英语频道的修辞重叠度接近于零，在SNC排名中垫底。这证实了单一指标不足以有效检测协同行为。
AI.conclusion: 多维度的合成叙事协调得分（SNC）比任何单一指标都能提供更稳健、更具解释性的协同检测信号。
AI.translation: 大语言模型的激增引入了合成政治传播的新范式，在这种范式中，叙事可以被大规模生成、语义协调并跨平台进行战略性传播。我们提出了一个用于检测合成政治叙事的跨平台框架，该框架结合了四个协调信号——词汇多样性 D(C)、时间突发性 B(C)、修辞重复性 R(C) 和语义同质性 H(C)，并将其合并为合成叙事协调得分 SNC(C)。我们将该框架应用于一个包含 353,223 条记录的语料库，这些记录跨越了从 6 个 Telegram 频道和 9 个 Reddit 社区收集的六个地缘政治事件窗口（2023-2026 年）。结果表明，IntelSlava 表现出最低的词汇多样性（MATTR 0.52-0.54）、最高的突发性（B=+0.48 至 +0.73）以及与同行频道最高的修辞重叠度（Jaccard 0.12），在六个事件窗口中的四个中在综合 SNC(C) 中排名第一（SNC 0.45-0.60）。尽管 Rybar 的语义同质性很高，但它在所有窗口中都排名最后，因为其俄语输出导致了高词汇多样性，且与英语频道的修辞 Jaccard 系数接近于零——这表明没有任何单一指标足以进行协调检测。多维度 SNC(C) 评分比任何单一指标都提供了更稳健、更具解释性的信号。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型时代跨平台合成政治叙事的大规模传播问题，提出了一个结合词汇多样性、时间突发性、修辞重复性和语义同质性的多维度检测框架（SNC）。通过对Telegram和Reddit的大规模数据集进行分析，研究验证了该多维度框架在识别协同政治传播中的有效性与稳健性。
AI.keywords: 合成政治叙事, 协同检测, 跨平台分析, 大语言模型, 社交媒体
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一个整合词汇、时间、修辞和语义四个维度的多指标合成叙事协调得分（SNC），有效克服了以往依赖单一指标进行协同检测的局限。然而，研究也暴露出在处理跨语言（如俄语与英语频道）协同检测时的局限性，表明多语言环境下的跨平台叙事对齐仍是一个挑战。

title: Frequency-Domain Regularized Adversarial Alignment for Transferable Attacks against Closed-Source MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain vulnerable to transfer-based targeted attacks, where perturbations optimized on open-source surrogate encoders can generalize to closed-source MLLMs. A key challenge for improving adversarial transferability is to effectively capture the intrinsic visual focus shared across different models, such that perturbations align with transferable semantic cues rather than surrogate-specific behaviors. However, existing methods suffer from spatial-domain feature redundancy and surrogate-specific gradient signals, thereby hindering cross-model transferability. In this paper, we propose FRA-Attack, which addresses both challenges from a unified frequency-domain regularization perspective. For feature alignment, a high-pass DCT objective on patch features suppresses redundant global structures and concentrates the loss on the high-frequency band that carries the MLLMs' intrinsic visual focus. For gradient optimization, we introduce Frequency-domain Gradient Regularization (FGR), a \textit{model-agnostic} low-pass regularizer that modulates the surrogate gradient using only the geometric frequency coordinate, \textit{i.e.}, no surrogate-derived statistic is involved, so that FGR is model-agnostic by construction, removing surrogate-specific high-frequency artifacts while preserving transferable low-frequency directions. Together, the two components form a unified frequency-domain treatment of transferability. Extensive experiments on $15$ flagship MLLMs across $7$ vendors show that FRA-Attack achieves superior cross-model transferability, particularly with state-of-the-art performance on GPT-5.4, Claude-Opus-4.6 and Gemini-3-flash.

AI.title_translation: 针对闭源多模态大语言模型的可迁移攻击的频域正则化对抗对齐
AI.tldr: 本文提出了FRA-Attack，一种通过频域高通特征对齐和模型无关的低通梯度正则化，来显著提升针对闭源多模态大语言模型可迁移对抗攻击性能的方法。
AI.motivation: 提高对抗样本在多模态大语言模型（MLLM）间可迁移性的关键在于，捕获不同模型间共享的内在视觉焦点，使扰动与可迁移语义线索对齐。然而，现有方法受到空间域特征冗余和代理模型特有梯度信号的干扰，阻碍了跨模型的可迁移性。
AI.method:
提出FRA-Attack方法，从统一的频域正则化角度解决迁移攻击挑战：
1. **特征对齐**：在图像块（patch）特征上采用高通离散余弦变换（DCT）目标，抑制冗余的全局结构，并将损失集中在携带MLLMs本质视觉焦点的高频频段。
2. **梯度优化**：引入频域梯度正则化（FGR），这是一种模型无关的低通正则化器，仅使用几何频率坐标调制代理梯度（不涉及代理模型统计数据），在去除代理模型特有高频伪影的同时保留可迁移的低频方向。
AI.result: 在来自7个厂商的15个旗舰MLLM上进行了广泛实验，结果表明FRA-Attack实现了优异的跨模型可迁移性，特别是在GPT-5.4、Claude-Opus-4.6和Gemini-3-flash上达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 频域正则化（结合高通特征对齐和低通梯度正则化）是提高针对闭源多模态大语言模型的可迁移对抗攻击的有效且统一的途径。
AI.translation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在基于迁移的目标攻击面前仍然显得脆弱，即在开源代理编码器上优化的扰动可以泛化到闭源的MLLMs。提高对抗可迁移性的一个关键挑战是有效捕获不同模型之间共享的内在视觉焦点，从而使扰动与可迁移的语义线索对齐，而不是与代理模型特有的行为对齐。然而，现有方法存在空间域特征冗余和代理模型特有梯度信号的问题，从而阻碍了跨模型的可迁移性。在本文中，我们提出了FRA-Attack，它从统一的频域正则化视角解决了这两个挑战。对于特征对齐，在图像块（patch）特征上的高通离散余弦变换（DCT）目标抑制了冗余的全局结构，并将损失集中在携带MLLMs内在视觉焦点的高频段。对于梯度优化，我们引入了频域梯度正则化（FGR），这是一种与模型无关的低通正则化器，它仅使用几何频率坐标来调制代理梯度，即不涉及任何源自代理模型的统计数据，因此FGR在构建上就是模型无关的，在去除代理模型特有的高频伪影的同时，保留了可迁移的低频方向。这两个部分共同构成了对可迁移性的统一频域处理方法。在来自7个厂商的15个旗舰MLLM上进行的广泛实验表明，FRA-Attack实现了优越的跨模型可迁移性，特别是在GPT-5.4、Claude-Opus-4.6和Gemini-3-flash上取得了最先进的性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对闭源多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的对抗迁移攻击问题，提出了FRA-Attack方法。该方法从统一的频域正则化视角出发，通过高通DCT特征对齐来捕获内在视觉焦点，并利用模型无关的低通频域梯度正则化（FGR）来消除代理模型特有的高频噪声。实验表明，该方法在多个主流闭源MLLMs上均取得了显著优越的跨模型迁移攻击效果。
AI.keywords: 频域正则化,多模态大语言模型,可迁移对抗攻击,特征对齐,梯度正则化
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将频域分析引入到多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的对抗迁移攻击中，通过高通特征对齐和低通梯度正则化双管齐下，有效解决了空间冗余和代理模型过拟合的问题。其在GPT-5.4、Claude-Opus-4.6等最先进闭源模型上的优异表现，充分证明了该方法的实用价值和研究前瞻性。不过，摘要中提到的“GPT-5.4”等型号命名较为奇特，可能需要结合具体实验设置进行理解。

title: Discovering Entity-Conditioned Lag Heterogeneity: A Lag-Gated Neural Audit Framework for Panel Time Series
comments: Preprint/technical paper. An interpretable neural audit framework for entity-conditioned lag discovery in panel time series. 10 pages, 5 figures, 16 tables. Code available at the GitHub repository
summary: Country-level temporal panels are widely used in empirical analysis. Researchers often need to audit how different entities respond to historical signals over different time horizons. Current approaches typically do not provide directly auditable entity-specific lag summaries. We formulate entity-conditioned heterogeneous lag discovery as a temporal panel mining task and propose AC-GATE, an Adaptive-Conditioning Encoder with a Scale-Invariant Lag Gate. It instantiates conditional Moderated Distributed Lag by using observable entity-level proxies to condition lag-weight distributions over historical observations, thereby making effective lags structural outputs of the model rather than post-hoc explanations. The evaluation is based on a layered audit protocol that separates predictive calibration from lag discovery. A synthetic panel with known ground-truth lags is used for mechanism recovery testing, and two real-world country-level panels are used for external audit and stress testing. The results show that AC-GATE can recover heterogeneous lag structure in synthetic data, and generates non-degenerate, externally structured effective lags in real data.
comment: Preprint/technical paper. An interpretable neural audit framework for entity-conditioned lag discovery in panel time series. 10 pages, 5 figures, 16 tables. Code available at the GitHub repository

AI.title_translation: 发现实体条件下的滞后异质性：一种用于面板时间序列的滞后门控神经网络审计框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了AC-GATE框架，通过自适应条件编码器和尺度不变滞后门，直接从面板时间序列中挖掘并输出实体特异性的异质滞后结构。
AI.motivation: 在实证分析中，研究人员需要审计不同实体在不同时间跨度上对历史信号的反应，但现有方法通常无法提供可直接审计的、针对特定实体的滞后总结。
AI.method: 提出AC-GATE（具有尺度不变滞后门的自适应条件编码器）框架。它通过使用可观察的实体级代理来调节历史观测上的滞后权重分布，从而实例化条件调节的分布式滞后（Moderated Distributed Lag），使有效滞后直接作为模型的结构化输出。评估采用分层审计协议，将预测标定与滞后发现分离。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，AC-GATE能够成功恢复合成数据中已知的异质滞后结构，并在两个真实世界的国家级面板数据中生成非退化且具有外部结构化的有效滞后。
AI.conclusion: AC-GATE能够有效解决面板时间序列中实体条件下的异质滞后发现问题，实现了将有效滞后作为模型的结构化输出，并在合成与真实数据上均表现出良好的结构恢复和泛化能力。
AI.translation: 国家级时间面板在实证分析中被广泛使用。研究人员通常需要审计不同实体在不同时间跨度上对历史信号的反应。目前的方法通常无法提供可直接审计的、针对特定实体的滞后总结。我们将实体条件下的异质滞后发现表述为时间面板挖掘任务，并提出了AC-GATE，即一种具有尺度不变滞后门的自适应条件编码器。它通过使用可观测的实体级代理来调节历史观测值上的滞后权重分布，从而实例化了条件调节的分布式滞后（Moderated Distributed Lag），从而使有效滞后成为模型的结构化输出，而非事后解释。评估基于一个分层审计协议，该协议将预测标定与滞后发现分离开来。我们使用一个具有已知真实滞后的合成面板进行机制恢复测试，并使用两个真实世界的国家级面板进行外部审计和压力测试。结果表明，AC-GATE能够恢复合成数据中的异质滞后结构，并在真实数据中生成非退化的、外部结构化的有效滞后。
AI.summary: 本文针对面板时间序列中实体特异性滞后难以直接审计的问题，提出了一种名为AC-GATE的神经网络审计框架。该框架利用自适应条件编码器和尺度不变滞后门，将实体级代理与历史观测的滞后权重分布相结合，从而将有效滞后作为模型的结构化输出。通过在合成和真实国家级面板上的测试，验证了该方法在恢复异质滞后结构和生成有效滞后方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 面板时间序列, 滞后异质性, 神经网络审计, 分布式滞后, AC-GATE
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将异质滞后发现转化为时间面板挖掘任务，并通过引入“滞后门（Lag Gate）”机制，使有效滞后成为模型的内生结构化输出，避免了传统事后解释（post-hoc explanations）的不可靠性。其分层审计协议的设计也较为新颖，有效分离了预测性能与滞后发现的评估。局限性可能在于该方法依赖于可观察的实体级代理变量（entity-level proxies），若这些代理变量选择不当或难以获取，可能会影响滞后结构的准确调节。

title: Provable Joint Decontamination for Benchmarking Multiple Large Language Models
summary: Benchmark data contamination has become a central challenge in LLM evaluation: when evaluation examples appear in the training data of one or more audited models, reported performance can be inflated and cross-model comparisons become unreliable. A broad line of training-data detection work designs scores to quantify how strongly a model memorizes a given data point, but these score-based methods lack theoretical guarantees. Recent conformal approaches provide provable false-identification control for a single model; however, applying them separately to each model can produce model-specific benchmarks, undermining fair comparison across models. In this work, we formalize multi-model benchmark decontamination as a joint selection problem and propose Joint Envelope Conformal Selection (JECS), a conformal procedure that enables global contamination rate (GCR) control under stated assumptions. Specifically, JECS computes per-model conformal p-values, aggregates them by the per-item maximum, and reconstructs a conservative envelope of the max-p null distribution from right-tail observations above a data-driven threshold. By applying the adaptive Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure to the envelope-rescaled values, we select a benchmark with provable GCR control. Extensive experiments across various models and benchmarks demonstrate that JECS achieves higher power than the max-p baseline while consistently maintaining the target GCR control.

AI.title_translation: 用于多大语言模型基准测试的可证明联合去污染方法
AI.tldr: JECS是一种新的多模型基准去污染方法，通过联合共形选择确保全局污染率可控，解决了跨模型评估不公平的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的数据污染检测方法缺乏理论保证，且单独对每个模型进行去污染会导致基准测试不统一，从而破坏跨模型对比的公平性。
AI.method: 提出联合包络共形选择（JECS）方法，通过计算每模型的共形p值，取每项最大值并基于数据驱动的阈值构建最大p零分布的保守包络，随后应用自适应Benjamini-Hochberg（BH）程序进行选择。
AI.result: 实验表明，JECS在维持目标全局污染率（GCR）控制的同时，比传统的max-p基线方法具有更高的检测效能（power）。
AI.conclusion: JECS通过联合共形选择方法，在保证全局污染率控制的前提下，实现了更高效的基准数据去污染，为多模型性能评估提供了更可靠的基础。
AI.translation: 基准数据污染已成为大语言模型（LLM）评估的核心挑战：当评估示例出现在一个或多个受审计模型的训练数据中时，报告的性能可能会被夸大，导致跨模型比较变得不可靠。广泛的训练数据检测工作设计了评分来量化模型对给定数据点的记忆程度，但这些基于评分的方法缺乏理论保证。近期的共形方法为单个模型提供了可证明的错误识别控制；然而，将它们分别应用于每个模型会产生模型特定的基准，从而破坏了模型间的公平比较。在这项工作中，我们将多模型基准去污染形式化为一个联合选择问题，并提出了联合包络共形选择（JECS），这是一种在既定假设下实现全局污染率（GCR）控制的共形程序。具体来说，JECS计算每个模型的共形p值，通过每项最大值进行聚合，并从数据驱动阈值以上的右尾观测值中重建最大p零分布的保守包络。通过将自适应Benjamini-Hochberg（BH）程序应用于包络重缩放后的值，我们选择了一个具有可证明GCR控制的基准。在各种模型和基准测试上的广泛实验表明，与max-p基线相比，JECS在持续维持目标GCR控制的同时实现了更高的效能。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型基准测试中的数据污染问题，提出了一种名为联合包络共形选择（JECS）的方法。该方法通过联合选择框架对多个模型进行统一去污染，利用共形预测技术确保全局污染率受控，从而实现了更公平、可靠的模型性能评估。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 基准测试, 数据污染, 共形预测, 全局控制
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将基准污染检测问题转化为联合选择问题，并引入了共形预测框架来实现全局控制，解决了以往单模型检测导致的跨模型比较不公平的问题，具有重要的实践意义。

title: Tabular foundation models for robust calibration of near-infrared chemical sensing data
summary: Near-infrared spectroscopy is increasingly used as a rapid, non-destructive chemical sensing technology for the analysis of food, pharmaceutical, biological, and environmental samples. However, the practical deployment of NIR sensors still depends on calibration models able to handle high-dimensional, collinear spectra, limited sample sizes, preprocessing dependence, spectral outliers, and extrapolation beyond the calibration domain. Here, we evaluate whether tabular foundation models can provide a new calibration strategy for NIR chemical sensing. We benchmark TabPFN on 66 NIR datasets covering 54 regression and 12 classification tasks, and compare direct inference on raw spectra with preprocessing-optimized inference against PLS/PLS-DA, Ridge, Catboost, and one-dimensional convolutional neural networks. The study uses a unified validation framework in which preprocessing and model selection are performed exclusively on calibration data before external test evaluation. In regression, preprocessing-optimized TabPFN achieves the best overall average rank and significantly outperforms PLS, CatBoost, TabPFN on raw spectra, and CNN-1D, while remaining statistically comparable to Ridge. In classification, TabPFN applied directly to raw spectra provides the best average rank, with performance close to the optimized variant. Robustness analyses show that TabPFN provides strong average predictive performance but that its advantage decreases on spectral outliers and extrapolated samples, where classical chemometric models remain competitive. These results suggest that tabular foundation models can complement established chemometric workflows for NIR chemical sensing, especially in small- to medium-sized calibration settings, while highlighting the need for spectroscopy-specific priors and uncertainty-aware deployment strategies.

title: RefusalBench: Why Refusal Rate Misranks Frontier LLMs on Biological Research Prompts
comments: 34 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables (10 in main text, 2 in supplementary). Code and data: https://github.com/AppliedScientific/refusalbench
summary: Frontier large language models are increasingly deployed as orchestration backbones for biological research workflows, yet no shared evidence base exists for comparing their refusal behaviour on legitimate research prompts. RefusalBench, introduced here, is a matched-triple benchmark of 141 prompts in 47 bundles that holds task framing constant while varying only biological risk tier (benign, borderline, dual-use), enabling tier-conditioned comparisons robust to subdomain confounding. A 15-prompt should-refuse positive-control module establishes per-model calibration floors; three models fail to refuse even these prompts. Across 19 frontier models in the May 2026 snapshot, strict refusal rates span 0.1% to 94.6% on identical prompts. Jurisdiction does not predict refusal in this snapshot (Mann-Whitney U, p = 0.393; EU n = 1, US bimodal); provider identity does, with Anthropic's API stack predicting refusal at OR = 21.03 (95% CI: 14.58-30.34 prompt-clustered; 5.70-77.55 under model-clustered GEE). This effect is best read as access-path-level rather than model-weight-level: 99.8% of Anthropic's strict refusals carry the same safety_policy adjudicated reason code, consistent with a small set of canonical refusal templates rather than case-by-case model reasoning. Strict refusal rate misranks safety calibration: Grok 4.20 achieves the highest tier discrimination (Youden's J = 0.787) while ranking only seventh by overall refusal rate, and Claude Opus 4.7's J dropped 65% from prior versions with no improvement in dual-use detection. Nine of 18 frontier models exhibit a hedge-but-help partial-compliance pattern at dual-use tier that binary refusal metrics cannot detect.
