title: BeLink: Biomedical Entity Linking Meets Generative Re-Ranking
summary: Despite recent progress, Biomedical Entity Linking (BEL) with large language models (LLMs) remains computationally inefficient and challenging to deploy in practical settings. In this work, we demonstrate that instruction-tuning of open-source generative models can offer an effective solution when applied at the re-ranking stage of the BEL pipeline. We propose a set-wise instruction-tuning formulation that enables fast and accurate candidate selection. Our method demonstrates strong performance on multiple BEL benchmarks, yielding significant improvements in linking accuracy (3%-24%) while reducing inference time compared to the state-of-the-art. We integrate our generative re-ranker into BeLink, a modular, end-to-end system designed for practical real-world BEL applications.

title: Compiling Agentic Workflows into LLM Weights: Near-Frontier Quality at Two Orders of Magnitude Less Cost
summary: Agent orchestration frameworks have proliferated, collectively exceeding 290,000 GitHub stars across LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Semantic Kernel, Strands, and LlamaIndex. All follow the same pattern: an external orchestrator above the LLM, injecting instructions and routing decisions every turn. Recent work has shown this architecture is dominated for procedural tasks by simply providing the procedure in a frontier model's system prompt [Dennis et al., 2026a], at the cost of consuming the context window, requiring a frontier model for every conversation, and exposing proprietary procedures to third-party providers. Compiling the procedure into the weights of a small fine-tuned model -- creating a subterranean agent -- should resolve all of these concerns, and prior work (SimpleTOD, FireAct, SynTOD, WorkflowLLM, Agent Lumos) has shown the technique works. Yet developer adoption has overwhelmingly favored orchestration. We identify three perceived barriers and address each empirically across travel booking (14 nodes), Zoom support (14 nodes, product-specific knowledge), and insurance claims (55 nodes, 6 decision hubs).

title: LACO: Adaptive Latent Communication for Collaborative Driving
summary: Collaborative driving aims to improve safety and efficiency by enabling connected vehicles to coordinate under partial observability. Recent approaches have evolved from sharing visual features for perception to exchanging language-based reasoning through foundation models for behavioral coordination. Though communicating in language provides intuitive information, it introduces two challenges: high latency caused by autoregressive decoding and information loss caused by compressing rich internal representations into discrete tokens. To address these challenges, we analyze latent communication in collaborative driving under inherent limitations of multi-agent settings. Our analysis reveals agent identity confusion, where direct fusion of latent states entangles decision representations across vehicles. Motivated by this, we propose LACO, a training-free \textbf{LA}tent \textbf{CO}mmunication paradigm that seamlessly adapts pretrained driving models to collaborative settings. LACO introduces Iterative Latent Deliberation (ILD) for latent reasoning, Cross-Horizon Saliency Attribution (CHSA) for communication-efficient information selection, and Structured Semantic Knowledge Distillation (SSKD) to stabilize ego-centric decision making. Closed-loop experiments in CARLA show that LACO notably reduces communication and inference latency while maintaining strong collaborative driving performance.

title: Towards Direct Evaluation of Harness Optimizers via Priority Ranking
summary: Harness optimization enables automated agent creation by having an optimizer agent iteratively update the harness of target agents. Despite its success, current studies evaluate optimizers solely by observing target agents' performance gains. This indirect end-improvement evaluation neglects optimizers' actions at intermediate steps, which are often erroneous and hinder agent performance. Therefore, it is unclear whether harness optimization is driven by optimizers' informed update actions or simply trial-and-error. This necessitates direct evaluation of harness optimizers. However, evaluating harness optimizers directly is non-trivial and costly due to the lack of oracle harnesses. To address this, we present a simple, low-cost design to directly evaluate them, namely priority ranking. By asking harness optimizers to rank components (e.g., tools) in a given harness by their potential to improve/hinder agent performance when updated, our design quantifies optimizer ability at the step level without expensive rollouts or manual examination. More importantly, optimizers' ranking performance correlates with their ability to improve agents in actual multi-step harness optimization, establishing priority ranking as a reliable predictor of optimization ability. Priority ranking is enabled by Shor, a collection of 182 human-verified optimization scenarios spanning across domains, designs, and time stages. Codes and data can be found at https://github.com/k59118/Harness_Optimizer_Evaluation.

title: EnCAgg: Enhanced Clustering Aggregation for Robust Federated Learning against Dynamic Model Poisoning
summary: Federated learning faces increasing threats from model poisoning attacks, which harms its application to improve privacy. Existing defense methods typically rely on fixed thresholds or perform clustering with a fixed number of clusters to distinguish malicious gradients from benign ones. However, these methods are difficult to adapt to dynamic poisoning strategies of malicious clients, and often result in the loss of benign gradients due to the heterogeneity of clients' local datasets. To address these problems, we propose a novel robust aggregation method that leverages a small number of known benign clients as references, enabling accurate identification and filtering of malicious gradients while retaining as many benign gradients as possible, even when the number of malicious clients is unknown and variable. First, we introduce a density-based low-dimensional gradient clustering method, which projects gradients onto the two most divergent dimensions and applies density-based clustering to identify malicious gradients while retaining clustered benign gradients and potentially benign outliers. Second, we design an enhancing clustering low-dimensional gradient generator model, which learns to generate pseudo-gradients aligned with the boundary of the benign cluster. These pseudo-gradients act as bridges to connect sparse benign gradient outliers. Third, we introduce low-dimensional gradient re-clustering that clusters the generated pseudo-gradients together with real gradients to recover benign gradients misclassified as noise points, enabling more benign gradients to participate in aggregation. Extensive experiments on the MNIST, CIFAR-10, and MIND datasets demonstrate that our method exhibits superior fidelity and robustness under dynamic poisoning scenarios.

title: Generative Modeling by Value-Driven Transport
summary: We propose a new framework for generative modeling based on a discrete-time stochastic control formulation of measure transport. Adapting classic results from control theory, we formulate our problem as a linear program whose dual variables correspond to the \emph{optimal value function} of the control problem, which directly encodes the optimal control policy. Exploiting this LP formulation, we develop an efficient simulation-free primal-dual algorithm for computing approximately optimal value functions and the associated \emph{value-driven transport} (VDT) policies which approximate the true optimal policy. We show that well-trained VDT policies enjoy numerous favorable properties in comparison with other state-of-the-art methods based on flows, diffusions, or Schrödinger bridges: they lead to straight transport paths which can be simulated quickly and robustly, and can be enhanced in all the same ways as diffusion and flow-based models (e.g., conditional generation, classifier-free guidance, unpaired data-to-data translation are all easy to incorporate). We evaluate our methodology in a range of experiments, with results that indicate strong performance and good potential for scalability.

title: Fluid RIS (FRIS)-Assisted Index Modulation for 6G Wireless Communications
summary: Fluid reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (FRIS) extend conventional reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) by adding spatial reconfigurability through switchable apertures, pattern-reconfigurable units, fluidic conductive materials, or movable surface elements. This article studies how FRIS can support index modulation (IM), where information bits select a surface configuration and the receiver detects the index from the induced receiver-side response. A key challenge is that many feasible FRIS layouts do not necessarily lead to many reliable spatial indices. After propagation, mutual coupling, hardware distortion, and receiver observation, different layouts may produce similar receiver-side responses and cause index-detection errors. To address this issue, we present a response-aware design view, in which FRIS spatial codebooks are selected according to response-domain separability rather than layout diversity alone. We also discuss actuation granularity as a practical design knob that balances spatial diversity, pilot overhead, coupling robustness, and hardware feasibility. The resulting workflow helps select compact, trainable, and controllable spatial-index codebooks from dense FRIS layouts, providing design guidance for future programmable wireless environments.

title: Reflecti-Mate: A Conversational Agent for Adaptive Decision-Making Support Through System 1 and System 2 Thinking
summary: Making high-stakes personal decisions involves cognitive, emotional, and intuitive processes, and individuals differ in how they allocate attention across these modes. Integration of these processes has shown to benefit decision making. Yet, most current decision-support systems focus primarily on supporting cognitive aspects, rather than adapting to the individual's thinking profile to support integration of different types of thoughts. In this study, we investigate an agent designed to encourage integration by adapting to the individual user's thought patterns. We explore its effects on participants' perceptions of the agent and their reflective behavior, in comparison with unaided pre-reflection and a baseline agent. In a between-subjects study (N = 128), our agent, which fostered broad and elaborated thinking, enabled more personalized reflective trajectories, elicited more integrative reflective language, and was perceived as providing stronger support for holistic reflection. In contrast, the baseline agent produced homogenized profiles dominated by cognitive language across participants.

title: Search-E1: Self-Distillation Drives Self-Evolution in Search-Augmented Reasoning
summary: Post-training has become the dominant recipe for turning a language model into a competent search-augmented reasoning agent. A line of recent work pushes its performance further by adding elaborate machinery on top of this standard pipeline. These augmentations import external supervision from stronger external systems, attach auxiliary modules such as process reward models or retrospective critics, restructure the rollout itself with tree search or multi-stage curricula, or shape the reward with hand-crafted bonuses and penalties. Each addition delivers a measurable gain, but each also inflates the training pipeline and ties the recipe to resources or designs that may not always be available. We take a step back and ask whether any of this machinery is actually necessary, and propose Search-E1, a self-evolution method that lets a search-augmented agent improve through only vanilla GRPO interleaved with offline self-distillation (OFSD). After each GRPO round, the policy rolls out on its own training questions. A token-level forward KL objective then aligns the policy's inference-time distribution to its own distribution under a privileged context that exposes a more efficient sibling trajectory. Despite this simplicity, the procedure naturally provides dense per-step supervision. On seven QA benchmarks, Search-E1 reaches $0.440$ average EM with Qwen2.5-3B, surpassing all open-source baselines at both scales. Code and complete version will be made public soon.

title: Meta-Learning for Rapid Adaptation in Reference Tracking of Uncertain Nonlinear Systems
summary: In this paper, we address the problem of reference tracking for uncertain nonlinear systems. Since collecting data from the target system (i.e., the system of interest) is often challenging, our objective is to design optimal controllers using limited target system data. Meta-learning provides a promising paradigm by leveraging offline data from source systems (systems sharing structural similarities with the target system) to accelerate training and enhance control performance. Motivated by this idea, we propose a meta-learning-based control framework that tailors the implicit model-agnostic meta-learning (iMAML) algorithm to the control setting. The framework operates in two phases: an (offline) meta-training phase, where an aggregated representation is learned from source data to capture the shared system dynamics among similar systems, and an (online) meta-adaptation phase, where this representation is fine-tuned on the target system using only a few data samples and limited adaptation steps. We formulate this framework as a bi-level optimization problem and provide an efficient solution with reduced storage complexity and few approximations. The proposed framework is general, allowing various learning algorithms to be integrated. To demonstrate this flexibility, we propose two specific learning algorithms that can be incorporated into our framework based on a neural state-space model and a deep Q-network, respectively. The primary distinction between these approaches is whether explicit system identification is required. Numerical simulations and hardware experiments demonstrate that the proposed methods enhance control performance and consistently outperform baseline approaches.

title: A Symbolic Homotopy Algorithm for Solving Composable Polynomial Systems
summary:
We study the problem of computing the isolated regular solutions of a system \((f_1,\ldots,f_n)\) of \(n\) polynomial equations in \(n\) variables \((X_1, \dots, X_n)\) over a field of characteristic zero \(k\). We focus on systems with a \emph{composable structure}, where each polynomial \(f_i\) can be expressed as a composition \( f_i = h_i(g_1,\dots,g_n)\). Exploiting this structure allows us to reduce the original system to one in the \(g_j\) variables, thereby significantly improving the efficiency of symbolic solution algorithms. We present a probabilistic algorithm that computes all isolated regular solutions, with arithmetic complexity being polynomial in the input size and in the number of solutions.
  A first important application is when \(f_1, \dots, f_n\) belong to the subring \(k[g_1, \dots, g_n]\), where \(g_1, \dots, g_n\) are algebraically independent polynomials in \(k[X_1, \dots, X_n]\). Another important application is to systems of invariant polynomials under finite reflection groups, since by the Chevalley-Shephard-Todd theorem their invariant rings are polynomial algebras. Typical examples include the symmetric groups \(S_n\), the hyperoctahedral groups \(B_n\), the dihedral groups \(I_2(m)\), and the exceptional finite reflection groups \(E_6, E_7, E_8, F_4, H_3, H_4\).

title: Quantifying Full-Body Immersion
comments: This manuscript is under consideration for possible publication in the Nature. Copyright may be transferred to Nature if the manuscript is accepted for publication, without further notice
summary: Humanity is at the forefront of yet another digital revolution, where the lines between real and virtual worlds are dissolving, reshaping how we perceive and interact with our surroundings. In this context, we introduce a transformative paradigm for immersive virtual experiences centered around whole-body kinetic interactions. Our approach redefines immersion through three distinct levels: audio-visual immersion, capturing sensory realism; physical immersion, delivering haptic feedback; and full-body immersion (FBI), where dynamic bodily interaction integrates seamlessly with virtual environments. At the core of this innovation lies a scalable, distributable platform based on modular robotic surface units inspired by the adaptive designs of nature. These units enable the rendering of immersive environments at any scale, from intimate personal experiences to expansive multi-user settings, dynamically adapting to interactions in real-time. The modular system distributes force, shape, and motion feedback throughout entire spaces, replicating the physical characteristics of the environment and enabling new depth of engagement through FBI. By combining scalability, adaptability, and dynamic physical engagement, this framework bridges the gap between real and virtual worlds. It offers an unprecedented level of immersion where users can engage their entire bodies in symbiotic interactions with the virtual space. This work not only advances immersive technology but also redefines how humans and virtual environments coexist, setting a foundation for a new era of human-environment synthesis.

title: EnCoR: An end-to-end architecture for simplifying cellular networks
summary: Since their creation, cellular networks have made in-network mobility support a key feature of their service model. While this approach provides seamless connectivity for legacy traffic, it has the side effects of inflating end-user latency and increasing complexity and operational overhead for operators. Yet modern applications and transport protocols are increasingly mobility tolerant, prompting us to revisit the assumption that mobility must be provided as an in-network service. In this paper, we propose EnCoR (End-to-End Core and RAN), a deployable cellular network architecture that removes mobility from the core entirely. Leveraging end-to-end mobility, EnCoR eliminates tunnel-based IP anchoring while preserving compatibility with existing authentication, charging, and QoS techniques. We demonstrate that EnCoR works with unmodified phones while providing equivalent performance as traditional LTE networks for real applications including video and voice calling and video streaming. We show that EnCoR not only allows network operators to reduce end to end latency, but can also reduce the capital cost of providing low latency service to users by more than 90% compared to 3GPP networks, based on cost estimates for cellular network core and border router infrastructure provided by the FCC. Finally, we demonstrate that these gains are achieved while reducing the amount of overall handover control messaging, allowing the EnCoR core network to handle a greater number of mobility handover events than an LTE core under identical hardware constraints, achieving a 2.6x lower handover latency under load.

title: "Refactoring Runaway": Understanding and Mitigating Tangled Refactorings in Coding Agents for Issue Resolution
summary: Recent advances in coding agents have shown remarkable progress in software issue resolution. In practice, real-world issues are typically bug fixes or feature requests in which human developers naturally incorporate refactoring as part of the resolution process, resulting in tangled refactoring. Since LLMs are trained on large-scale open-source repositories, coding agents may inherit such behaviors. In this paper, we conduct an empirical study on Multi-SWE-bench, analyzing 3,691 valid patches generated by three agent frameworks with 12 LLMs. We find that coding agents introduce tangled refactorings less frequently (21.43% vs. 36.72%) and with lower intensity (0.66 vs. 1.75) than human developers, although they exhibit a broader diversity of refactoring types. Logistic regression analysis further shows that tangled refactorings are strongly associated with reduced compilability, while exhibiting no significant association with functional correctness. Based on these findings, we propose a refactoring-aware refinement approach that assesses the necessity and safety of tangled refactorings and selectively removes or repairs problematic operations. Our approach improves compilability from 19.34% to 38.33%, and additionally resolves 2.79% previously unresolved issues. Overall, this work presents the first step towards understanding tangled refactoring practices in agentic issue resolution and opens up avenues for future work.

title: Quantum Genetic Optimization for Negative Selection Algorithms in Anomaly Detection
summary: Negative Selection Algorithms (NSAs), inspired by the self/non-self discrimination mechanism of the human immune system, have been widely employed in anomaly detection. However, their effectiveness is often constrained by the efficiency of detector generation. This paper presents the Quantum Genetic Negative Selection Algorithm (QGNSA), a novel approach that integrates a Quantum Genetic Algorithm (QGA) into the EvoSeedRNSA algorithm, replacing its classical evolutionary optimization process. The proposed method exploits quantum superposition and probabilistic amplitude adjustment to enhance search space exploration and convergence efficiency in the detector generation process. Empirical evaluations using the Metaverse Financial Transactions Dataset demonstrate that QGNSA achieves superior anomaly detection accuracy compared to its classical counterpart while maintaining robustness under varying hyperparameter configurations. The experimental results highlight the potential advantages of quantum computing in artificial immune systems, particularly in high-dimensional anomaly detection tasks. Future research will focus on further optimizing quantum circuit design, deploying the algorithm on real quantum hardware, and exploring hybrid quantum-classical approaches for improved computational efficiency.

title: Multi-Winner Voting Games in TU and NTU: When is the Core Always Non-Empty?
summary:
Multi-winner approval voting selects a size-$k$ committee that aggregates voters' approval preferences over a set of alternatives. A central question is coalitional stability: No coalition should be able to pick a committee -- of size at most its proportional share -- under which every coalition member has strictly more approved alternatives. This notion, introduced by Aziz et al. (2017) as core-stable committees, is naturally interpreted as a core notion with non-transferable utility.
  We introduce multi-winner voting games, a cooperative-game framework that unifies prior work and supports a systematic study of two utility-transfer models across different voting rules. Players are voters. Each coalition has a proportional seat cap and may only propose admissible committees up to that size. Fixing a multi-winner rule, each admissible committee induces a utility vector for the members of the coalition.
  In the transferable utility (TU) model, a coalition may redistribute the total utility of an admissible committee among its members. In the non-transferable utility (NTU) model, a coalition may only use utility vectors that are realized directly by some admissible committee. The core consists of utility vectors feasible for the grand coalition that are not blocked by any coalition. A coalition is blocking if it can propose an admissible committee that makes all its members strictly better off, directly in NTU and after redistribution in TU. When instantiated with the standard PAV/approval utility, the NTU-core is equivalent to the core-stable committee concept studied in prior work. To our knowledge, the TU-core for multi-winner voting has not been previously studied.
  We analyze core existence and computation for four prominent rules: Approval Voting (AV), Satisfaction Approval Voting (SAV), Chamberlin--Courant (CC), Proportional Approval Voting (PAV).

title: Stabilising Explainability Fragility in Cybersecurity AI: The Impact and Mitigation of Multicollinearity in Public Benchmark Datasets
comments: 35 pages, 3 figures, submitted to ACM TAISAP
summary: This paper investigates a unexplored yet impactful vulnerability in AI explainability used in intrusion detection (IDS): multicollinearity-induced instability. Despite extensive reliance on post-hoc explainability tools such as SHAP or LIME, the impact of correlated features on explanation robustness is not evaluated. We introduce a formal theorem stating that multicollinearity inflates attribution variance. This demonstrates that explanations and feature importances are non-identifiable under multicollinearity. A suite of comprehensive experiments validates the theorem on a representative benchmark dataset, UNSW-NB15. Four widely used families of models are evaluated, including linear, tree-based, kernel, and neural, across full and pruned feature sets based on VIF and correlation thresholding. We propose the novel metric of Explanability Fragility Score and two novel methods to mitigate it with variable integration complexity. CAA-Filtering focuses on stabilising explanations by grouping attributions of trained models. SHARP is a novel training-time regularisation framework that penalises attribution instability, enabling controllable and monotonic improvement of explainability stability. The findings support stable predictive performance, using Kendall's τ to quantify instability across bootstrapped explanations. This work has direct implications for the trustworthiness and reproducibility of XAI in security-critical contexts, and motivates incorporating multicollinearity mitigations into the IDS pipelines, providing a set of guidelines for practitioners.
comment: 35 pages, 3 figures, submitted to ACM TAISAP

AI.title_translation: 稳定网络安全人工智能中的可解释性脆弱性：公共基准数据集中多重共线性的影响与缓解
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了多重共线性对网络安全AI解释稳定性的负面影响，并提出了“可解释性脆弱性得分”以及两种缓解方法（CAA-Filtering和SHARP），在保证预测性能的同时显著提升了XAI的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 在网络安全入侵检测（IDS）中，尽管广泛使用SHAP或LIME等事后可解释性工具，但相关特征（多重共线性）对解释鲁棒性的负面影响尚未得到评估和解决。这导致安全AI的解释结果可能存在不稳定性，从而影响其可信度。
AI.method:
1. 理论推导：提出一个正式定理，证明多重共线性会使归因方差膨胀，导致解释和特征重要性不可识别。
2. 评估指标：提出“可解释性脆弱性得分”（Explainability Fragility Score）来量化不稳定性。
3. 缓解方法：
   - CAA-Filtering：一种事后（post-hoc）方法，通过对已训练模型的归因进行分组来稳定解释。
   - SHARP：一种新型训练期正则化框架，通过惩罚归因不稳定性，实现可解释性稳定性的可控和单调提升。
4. 实验设计：在UNSW-NB15数据集上，对线性、树、核、神经网络四类模型在完整和经VIF及相关性阈值修剪的特征集上进行评估。
AI.result: 实验验证了理论的正确性。所提出的缓解方法在保持稳定预测性能的同时，能够有效降低可解释性脆弱性。使用Kendall's τ指标量化自助法（bootstrapped）解释，结果证实了解释稳定性的显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 多重共线性会导致AI解释和特征重要性的不可识别性，降低XAI的可信度。通过引入所提的缓解方法（CAA-Filtering和SHARP），可以在保持稳定预测性能的同时，显著提升可解释性的鲁棒性。因此，在入侵检测系统（IDS）等安全关键领域的管线中，应当纳入多重共线性缓解措施。
AI.translation: 本文研究了入侵检测（IDS）中所使用的人工智能可解释性中一个尚未被探索但影响深远的脆弱性：多重共线性引起的 Lloyds 不稳定性。尽管广泛依赖于诸如 SHAP 或 LIME 之类的事后（post-hoc）可解释性工具，但相关特征对解释鲁棒性的影响尚未得到评估。我们引入了一个形式化定理，指出多重共线性会扩大归因方差。这表明在多重共线性下，解释和特征重要性是不可识别的。一套全面的实验在代表性基准数据集 UNSW-NB15 上验证了该定理。评估了四种广泛使用的模型系列，包括线性、基于树、核和神经网络，涵盖了基于方差膨胀因子（VIF）和相关性阈值过滤的完整特征集和修剪特征集。我们提出了新的“可解释性脆弱性得分”（Explanability Fragility Score）度量指标，以及两种具有不同变量集成复杂度的缓解方法。CAA-Filtering 侧重于通过对已训练模型的归因进行分组来稳定解释。SHARP 是一种新型的训练期正则化框架，它惩罚归因的不稳定性，从而实现可解释性稳定性的可控和单调提升。研究结果支持稳定的预测性能，并使用 Kendall's τ 来量化自助法（bootstrapped）解释中的不稳定性。这项工作对安全关键背景下 XAI 的可信度和可重复性具有直接影响，并激励将多重共线性缓解措施纳入 IDS 流程中，为从业者提供了一套指南。
AI.summary: 本文研究了网络安全入侵检测系统（IDS）中由于特征多重共线性导致AI解释（如SHAP、LIME）不稳定的问题。作者在理论上证明了多重共线性会扩大归因方差，并提出了“可解释性脆弱性得分”进行量化。为了解决该问题，本文提出了CAA-Filtering（事后归因分组）和SHARP（训练期正则化框架）两种缓解方法。实验表明，这些方法在不影响预测性能的前提下，有效提升了AI解释的稳定性和可信度。
AI.keywords: 可解释人工智能, 多重共线性, 入侵检测系统, 解释鲁棒性, 网络安全
AI.comments: 本文首次系统地探讨了多重共线性对网络安全领域AI可解释性（XAI）鲁棒性的负面影响，具有很强的现实意义。其创新之处在于不仅在理论上证明了多重共线性如何导致解释的不确定性，还从“事后处理（CAA-Filtering）”和“训练期正则化（SHARP）”两个阶段提出了具体的缓解方案，并设计了定量评估指标。这对于提升安全敏感型应用中人工智能决策的可信度和可重复性具有重要价值。

title: A Subjective Logic-based method for runtime confidence updates in safety arguments
comments: Accepted for publication at the 41st ACM/SIGAPP Symposium on Applied Computing (SAC 2026)
summary: We present a method for dynamic quantitative assurance that enhances static safety cases with continuous, runtime-driven confidence updates. The method quantifies and propagates confidence across the development lifecycle by integrating design-time evidence and windowed runtime Safety Performance Indicators (SPIs) within a single Subjective Logic (SL)-based assurance case. At runtime, SPI evidence is continuously evaluated, and targeted claims are updated using a rule that increases confidence in the absence of violations and imposes prompt penalties when violations occur. This design prioritizes safety-relevant responsiveness over exact classical Bayesian posterior updates. We demonstrate the method using a simulation-based construction zone assist function, focusing on an ML-based construction cone detection component, and show how confidence evolves as SPI evidence is observed in operation.
comment: Accepted for publication at the 41st ACM/SIGAPP Symposium on Applied Computing (SAC 2026)

AI.title_translation: 一种基于主观逻辑的安全论证运行时置信度更新方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于主观逻辑的方法，通过结合设计时证据和运行时安全性能指标（SPI），实现了安全论证中置信度的动态、快速响应式更新。
AI.motivation: 传统的安全案例多为静态设计，缺乏在系统运行期间进行持续、动态和定量置信度更新的能力。为了应对这一挑战，需要一种能够将设计时证据与运行时实际安全性能指标（SPI）相结合的动态定量安全保证方法。
AI.method: 提出一种基于主观逻辑（SL）的保证案例方法。该方法在统一的框架内整合了设计时证据与窗口化的运行时安全性能指标（SPI）。在系统运行期间，持续评估SPI证据，并采用一种特定规则来更新目标声明的置信度：在未发生违规时逐步提高置信度，而一旦检测到违规，则立即执行惩罚以迅速降低置信度。
AI.result: 通过在基于模拟的施工区域辅助功能（重点针对基于机器学习的施工锥检测组件）中进行演示，成功展示了在系统运行并观察到SPI证据时，安全论证的置信度是如何动态演变和更新的。
AI.conclusion: 该设计成功实现了一种动态定量保证方法，且通过优先考虑与安全相关的响应性（即无违规时增加置信度，违规时迅速惩罚），相比于精确的经典贝叶斯后验更新，更适合于安全关键型系统的运行时监控。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种用于动态定量保证的方法，该方法通过持续的、运行时驱动的置信度更新来增强静态安全案例。该方法通过在基于主观逻辑（SL）的单一保证案例中整合设计时证据和窗口化运行时安全性能指标（SPI），在整个开发生命周期中量化和传播置信度。在运行时，系统会持续评估SPI证据，并使用特定规则更新针对性的声明，该规则在没有违规时增加置信度，并在发生违规时立即施加惩罚。这种设计优先考虑与安全相关的响应性，而非精确的经典贝叶斯后验更新。我们使用基于模拟的施工区域辅助功能（重点是基于机器学习的施工锥检测组件）演示了该方法，并展示了在运行中观察到SPI证据时置信度是如何演变的。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于主观逻辑（SL）的动态定量安全保证方法，旨在通过持续的运行时置信度更新来增强静态安全案例。该方法将设计时的证据与运行时的窗口化安全性能指标（SPI）相结合，在运行期间持续评估SPI，并采用“无违规渐进提升、有违规即刻惩罚”的规则更新置信度，从而提供比传统贝叶斯更新更具安全响应性的机制。最后，通过一个基于机器学习的施工锥检测模拟案例验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 主观逻辑, 运行时置信度更新, 安全论证, 安全性能指标, 动态保证
AI.comments:
创新点：该论文的创新之处在于将主观逻辑（Subjective Logic）引入到安全论证中，并设计了一种非贝叶斯、偏向安全响应性的快速惩罚更新规则，实现了设计时证据与运行时指标的有机结合。
重要性：解决了传统静态安全案例（Safety Case）无法应对运行时动态不确定性的问题，对于自动驾驶等依赖机器学习且处于动态环境中的安全关键系统具有重要应用价值。
局限性：摘要中该方法仅在基于模拟的施工区域辅助功能（ML组件）中进行了验证，在真实复杂物理系统中的实时性计算开销和鲁棒性仍有待进一步观察。

title: Disentanglement Beyond Generative Models with Riemannian ICA
summary: There is a gap between the theoretical foundations of disentanglement and the practice of modern representation learning. Existing theoretical frameworks, particularly Independent Component Analysis (ICA) and its nonlinear variants, assume a generative model with statistically independent latent variables underlying the data so that disentanglement amounts to identifying the latents that could have generated the data. This generative framework is interpretable and theoretically justified, but its strong assumptions make it difficult to apply to modern representation learning. Modern pretrained encoders often learn features that exhibit disentangled properties without making generative assumptions, yet there is no general theory for interpreting these features as independent factors of variation. We take a step toward such a theory by introducing Riemannian ICA (RICA), which replaces ICA's global generative model with local geometric structure. RICA is founded on the observation that in ICA, the factors of variation underlying a data point can be understood through radial curves emanating from the point that map to axis-aligned lines in the latent space. We formalize this perspective using Riemannian geometry and introduce our theory in a way that is consistent with the existing generative approach. Our main contribution is the disentanglement tensor, which encodes a second-order notion of disentanglement that we call pointwise disentanglement. This tensor depends on the Hessian of the data log likelihood as well as the Ricci curvature induced by the model. In a controlled source recovery setting with known ground-truth sources, RICA recovers sources across several manifolds, while the success of ICA baselines depends on the coordinates used to represent the observations. Our work provides a theoretical basis for studying local disentanglement without assuming a global generative model.

AI.title_translation: 借助黎曼ICA超越生成模型的解耦表示学习
AI.tldr: 本文引入了黎曼ICA（RICA），利用局部几何结构代替传统的全局生成模型，为无需全局生成假设的局部解耦研究奠定了理论基础。
AI.motivation: 现有的解耦理论（如非线性ICA）通常假设存在一个具有独立隐变量的全局生成模型，但这与现代表示学习（如预训练编码器在无生成假设下学到解耦特征）的实践存在脱节。目前缺乏一种通用的理论来解释和研究这种无需全局生成模型的局部解耦特征。
AI.method: 提出黎曼ICA（RICA）框架，用局部几何结构取代传统的全局生成模型。该方法利用黎曼几何，将数据点背后的变分因子形式化为从该点出发并映射到隐空间轴对齐直线的径向曲线。其核心是引入了“解耦张量”（disentanglement tensor），通过结合数据对数似然的Hessian矩阵和模型诱导的Ricci曲率，来编码一种二阶的“逐点解耦”（pointwise disentanglement）概念。
AI.result: 在已知真实源的受控源恢复实验中，RICA能够成功恢复跨越多个流形的源，而传统的ICA基线方法的成功高度依赖于表示观测值时所采用的坐标系统。
AI.conclusion: 本工作为在不做出全局生成模型假设的情况下，研究和理解局部解耦表示提供了坚实的理论基础。
AI.translation: 解耦表示学习的理论基础与现代表示学习的实践之间存在差距。现有的理论框架，特别是独立成分分析（ICA）及其非线性变体，假设存在一个具有统计独立隐变量的生成模型来生成数据，因此解耦等同于识别出可能生成这些数据的隐变量。这种生成框架具有可解释性且在理论上是合理的，但其强假设使其难以应用于现代表示学习。现代预训练编码器通常在不做出生成假设的情况下学习到表现出解耦特性的特征，然而目前还没有通用的理论将这些特征解释为独立的变分因子。我们通过引入黎曼ICA（RICA）向这一理论迈出了一步，它用局部几何结构代替了ICA的全局生成模型。RICA建立在以下观察之上：在ICA中，数据点背后的变分因子可以通过从该点发出的径向曲线来理解，这些曲线映射到隐空间中与轴对齐的直线。我们利用黎曼几何将这一视角形式化，并以一种与现有生成方法相一致的方式引入了我们的理论。我们的主要贡献是解耦张量（disentanglement tensor），它编码了一种被称为逐点解耦（pointwise disentanglement）的二阶解耦概念。该张量取决于数据对数似然的Hessian矩阵以及模型诱导的Ricci曲率。在具有已知真实源的受控源恢复设置中，RICA恢复了多个流形上的源，而ICA基线的成功则取决于用于表示观测值的坐标。我们的工作为在不假设全局生成模型的情况下研究局部解耦提供了理论基础。
AI.summary: 本文针对现代表示学习中无需全局生成模型假设即可展现解耦特性的现象，提出了一种名为黎曼ICA（RICA）的理论框架。RICA利用黎曼几何将传统的全局生成假设替换为局部几何结构，并引入了“解耦张量”来刻画逐点解耦。实验表明其在流形源恢复上具有优越性，为局部解耦提供了理论支撑。
AI.keywords: 黎曼ICA, 解耦表示学习, 局部几何结构, 解耦张量, 逐点解耦
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于打破了传统解耦理论对全局生成模型的强依赖，首次引入黎曼几何来刻画局部解耦。提出的“解耦张量”融合了Hessian矩阵和Ricci曲率，理论推导严密且极具启发性。不过，其局限性在于黎曼几何中的曲率和二阶导数计算在高维数据中可能面临极大的计算挑战，且目前主要在受控的流形源恢复任务上进行了验证，在更大规模的实际深度网络中的可行性仍需进一步探索。

title: Relational Linear Properties in Language Models: An Empirical Investigation
summary: Linear properties are ubiquitous in the representations of language models; however, testing them experimentally remains a challenging task. This work focuses on relational linearity: the hypothesis that, for a fixed relation (e.g., "plays"), the unembedding of an object (e.g., "trumpet") can be predicted from the embedding of its subject (e.g.,"Miles Davis") by a linear map. We present an experimental method to test the formulation of relational linearity by Marconato et al. (2025). Specifically, we introduce a probing method, based on Kullback-Leibler divergence, to evaluate this property and examine its variation across layers and paraphrased relational queries. It is also more efficient than previous work; for example, it avoids the crude Jacobian approximations used in Linear Relational Embeddings by Hernandez et al. (2024). Our findings across four datasets show that relational linearity varies across models, exhibits layer-wise patterns consistent with prior observations about linguistic information in model representations, and is differently affected by changes in how the relation is phrased.

AI.title_translation: 语言模型中的关系线性性质：一项实证研究
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于KL散度的高效探测方法，用于实证评估语言模型中的关系线性性质，并揭示了其在不同模型、层级和关系表述下的变化规律。
AI.motivation: 尽管线性性质在语言模型的表示中非常普遍，但通过实验对其进行测试仍然具有挑战性。现有的测试方法（例如线性关系嵌入）依赖于粗糙的雅可比逼近，效率较低，因此需要一种更高效、更准确的方法来评估关系线性。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度的探测方法，用于测试Marconato等人（2025）提出的关系线性公式。该方法能够评估关系线性在不同模型层以及改写的关系查询中的变化，并且避免了先前线性关系嵌入（LRE）方法中所使用的粗糙雅可比逼近，从而显著提高了计算效率。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上的实验结果表明，关系线性在不同模型之间存在差异，展现出与先前关于模型表示中语言信息观察相一致的层级模式，并且受到关系短语表述变化的不同程度影响。
AI.conclusion: 关系线性在语言模型中具有显著的模型差异性和层级模式，且容易受到关系措辞变化的影响。所提出的基于KL散度的探测方法为评估该性质提供了一种更高效、更实用的手段。
AI.translation: 线性性质在语言模型的表示中无处不在；然而，通过实验对其进行测试仍是一项具有挑战性的任务。本研究关注于关系线性（relational linearity）：即对于一个固定的关系（例如“演奏”），客体（如“小号”）的解嵌入（unembedding）可以通过线性映射从其主体（如“迈尔斯·戴维斯”）的嵌入中预测出来的假设。我们提出了一种实验方法来测试Marconato等人（2025年）提出的关系线性公式。具体而言，我们引入了一种基于Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度的探测方法来评估这一性质，并研究其在不同层和改写后的关系查询中的变化。该方法也比先前的研究更高效；例如，它避免了Hernandez等人（2024年）在“线性关系嵌入”（LRE）中所使用的粗糙雅可比逼近。我们在四个数据集上的发现表明，关系线性在不同模型之间存在差异，展现出与先前关于模型表示中语言信息的观察一致的逐层模式，并且受到关系措辞变化的不同影响。
AI.summary: 本文对语言模型中的“关系线性”进行了实证研究。作者提出了一种基于KL散度的高效探测方法，用于评估主体嵌入与客体解嵌入之间的线性映射关系，并分析了其在模型不同层及改写查询下的变化。实验结果证实了关系线性的存在及其受模型、层级和措辞影响的特征。
AI.keywords: 语言模型, 关系线性, 探测方法, KL散度, 实证研究
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一种基于KL散度的高效探测方法，克服了以往方法（如LRE）中雅可比逼近计算复杂、效率低下的问题。该研究深入探讨了关系线性在不同层和提示词变化下的表现，为理解大语言模型的内部知识表示提供了有力的实证支持。局限性在于主要依赖于特定的关系线性公式，且其在更广泛的复杂推理任务中的泛化能力仍有待进一步验证。

title: Why Are Agentic Pull Requests Merged or Rejected? An Empirical Study
comments: Accepted for publication in 23rd international conference on Mining Software Repositories (MSR 2026) : 5 pages, 3 tables, 1 figure
summary: AI coding agents increasingly submit pull requests (Agentic-PRs) to open-source repositories, yet their performance is commonly assessed using merge and rejection outcomes alone. We hypothesized that these outcome labels do not reliably reflect agent capability without considering review interactions. To test this, we conducted a decision-oriented analysis of 11,048 closed Agentic Pull Requests, refined to 9,799 human-reviewed PRs, and manually inspected 717 representative cases to recover decision rationale from interaction artifacts. We found that rejection outcomes substantially overstate agent error: only 35.7% of rejected PRs reflected clear agentic failures, while 31.2% were driven by workflow constraints and 33.1% lacked observable decision rationale. Among merged PRs, 15.4% required explicit reviewer involvement through feedback or direct commits, and 5.5% showed no visible interaction trace. We further observed systematic differences across agents, with Copilot and Devin more often embedded in reviewer-mediated workflows, while Codex and Cursor PRs were typically merged with minimal interaction. These results reject the assumption that PR outcomes alone capture agent performance and demonstrate the need for interaction-aware evaluation grounded in review behavior.
comment: Accepted for publication in 23rd international conference on Mining Software Repositories (MSR 2026) : 5 pages, 3 tables, 1 figure

AI.title_translation: 为什么智能体拉取请求会被合并或拒绝？一项实证研究
AI.tldr: 研究表明，单纯依靠PR是否被合并来评估AI编码智能体的能力是不可靠的；许多拒绝源于工作流限制而非智能体错误，而许多合并则依赖人类的协助。评估AI智能体需要引入关注人机交互过程的机制。
AI.motivation: 目前AI编码智能体提交的拉取请求（Agentic-PRs）通常仅根据“合并”或“拒绝”的最终结果来评估其性能，但作者假设，在不考虑评审交互过程的情况下，这些简单的结果标签无法可靠、准确地反映智能体的真实能力。
AI.method: 对11,048个已关闭的智能体PR（精简为9,799个经过人工评审的PR）进行了面向决策的实证分析，并手动检查了717个代表性案例，通过分析交互过程中的产物（如评语、提交记录等）来恢复人类评审员的决策依据。
AI.result:
1. 拒绝结果严重夸大了智能体的错误：仅有35.7%的被拒PR是因为明确的智能体失败，31.2%由工作流限制导致，33.1%缺乏可观察的决策依据。
2. 在被合并的PR中，有15.4%需要评审员进行显式的干预（如提供反馈或直接提交代码修改），5.5%没有留下任何可见的交互痕迹。
3. 不同的AI智能体表现出系统性差异：Copilot和Devin更常嵌入到需要评审员介导的工作流中，而Codex和Cursor的PR通常在极少交互的情况下被直接合并。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果否定了“仅凭PR合并或拒绝结果就能准确衡量智能体性能”的传统假设，证明了在评估AI编码智能体时，必须引入基于评审行为、关注人机交互过程的评估方法。
AI.translation: AI编码智能体越来越多地向开源仓库提交拉取请求（Agentic-PRs），然而它们的性能通常仅通过合并和拒绝的结果来评估。我们假设，如果不考虑评审交互，这些结果标签无法可靠地反映智能体的能力。为了验证这一点，我们对11,048个已关闭的智能体拉取请求进行了面向决策的分析，筛选出9,799个经过人工评审的PR，并手动检查了717个代表性案例，以从交互产物中恢复决策依据。我们发现，拒绝结果大大夸大了智能体的错误：只有35.7%的被拒PR反映了明确的智能体失败，而31.2%是由工作流限制驱动的，33.1%缺乏可观察的决策依据。在合并的PR中，15.4%需要评审员通过反馈或直接提交进行显式参与，5.5%没有显示出可见的交互痕迹。我们还进一步观察到不同智能体之间的系统性差异，Copilot和Devin更多地嵌入在评审员介导的工作流中，而Codex和Cursor的PR通常在极少交互的情况下被合并。这些结果否定了仅靠PR结果就能捕获智能体性能的假设，并表明需要建立在评审行为基础上的、关注交互的评估。
AI.summary: 本文对AI编码智能体提交的拉取请求（Agentic-PRs）的合并与拒绝决策进行了深入的实证研究。通过分析近万个经过人工评审的PR并手动剖析717个典型案例，研究发现传统的“合并/拒绝”二元结果并不能真实反映智能体的技术水平。许多拒绝并非源于智能体自身的代码错误，而许多合并则依赖于人类评审员的积极协助。研究强调，未来的AI智能体评估需要转向关注人机交互过程的“交互感知”评估。
AI.keywords: 智能体拉取请求 (Agentic PRs), 实证研究 (Empirical Study), 智能体评估 (Agent Evaluation), 软件工程 (Software Engineering)
AI.comments: 本文切中了当前AI软件工程（SWE）领域评估体系的一个关键痛点：过度简化地将PR合并率等同于智能体能力。通过大规模的实证研究和细致的手动分析，揭示了人类协作、工作流限制以及无显式决策依据等因素对最终结果的巨大干扰。这一发现对于未来构建更客观、更关注人机协同过程的AI智能体评估基准具有重要的指导意义。

title: TerminalWorld: Benchmarking Agents on Real-World Terminal Tasks
summary: We introduce TerminalWorld, a scalable data engine that automatically reverse-engineers high-fidelity evaluation tasks from "in-the-wild" terminal recordings. Processing 80,870 terminal recordings, the engine yields a full benchmark of 1,530 validated tasks, spanning 18 real-world categories, ranging from short everyday operations to workflows exceeding 50 steps, and covering 1,280 unique commands. From these, we curate a Verified subset of 200 representative, manually reviewed tasks. Comprehensive benchmarking on TerminalWorld-Verified across eight frontier models and six agents reveals that current systems still struggle with authentic terminal workflows, achieving a maximum pass rate of only 62.5%. Moreover, TerminalWorld captures real-world terminal capabilities distinct from existing expert-curated benchmarks (e.g., Terminal-Bench), with only a weak correlation to their scores (Pearson r=0.20). The automated engine makes TerminalWorld authentic and scalable by construction, enabling it to evaluate agents in real-world terminal environments as developer practices evolve. Data and code are available at https://github.com/EuniAI/TerminalWorld.

AI.title_translation: TerminalWorld：在真实世界终端任务上评估 Agent
AI.tldr: 本文推出 TerminalWorld，一个通过逆向工程真实终端记录自动生成评估任务的引擎；测试表明当前最先进 Agent 在真实终端任务上的最高通过率仅为 62.5%，揭示了现有系统的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有的专家策划基准（如 Terminal-Bench）无法完全捕获真实世界的终端能力，且难以随着开发者实践的演变而扩展，因此需要一个真实、可扩展的基准来评估 Agent 在真实终端环境中的表现。
AI.method: 开发了名为 TerminalWorld 的可扩展数据引擎，该引擎通过处理 80,870 个实际终端记录，自动逆向工程出 1,530 个高保真评估任务，并人工筛选出 200 个代表性任务组成 Verified（已验证）子集，用于对 8 个前沿模型和 6 个 Agent 进行全面基准测试。
AI.result: 在 TerminalWorld-Verified 上的测试显示，当前最先进的系统在应对真实终端工作流时依然吃力，最高通过率仅为 62.5%。此外，该基准与现有专家策划基准的分数相关性极弱（皮尔逊 r=0.20），表明其捕获了独特的真实终端能力。
AI.conclusion: TerminalWorld 凭借其自动化引擎，在构建上实现了真实性与可扩展性，能够随着开发者实践的不断演进，持续且有效地在真实终端环境中评估 Agent 的能力。
AI.translation: 我们引入了 TerminalWorld，这是一个可扩展的数据引擎，能够自动从“实际”的终端记录中逆向工程出高保真的评估任务。通过处理 80,870 个终端记录，该引擎生成了一个包含 1,530 个已验证任务的完整基准，涵盖 18 个真实世界类别，范围从简短的日常操作到超过 50 个步骤的工作流，并涉及 1,280 个独特的命令。在此基础上，我们精选出了一个由 200 个具有代表性、经过人工审查的任务组成的 Verified（已验证）子集。在 TerminalWorld-Verified 上对 8 个前沿模型和 6 个 Agent 进行的全面基准测试表明，当前的系统在应对真实的终端工作流时仍然面临困难，最高通过率仅为 62.5%。此外，TerminalWorld 捕捉到了与现有专家策划的基准（例如 Terminal-Bench）不同的真实终端能力，与其得分仅呈弱相关（皮尔逊 r=0.20）。该自动化引擎使 TerminalWorld 具有与生俱来的真实性和可扩展性，能够随着开发者实践的演变，在真实的终端环境中评估 Agent。数据和代码可在 https://github.com/EuniAI/TerminalWorld 获取。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 TerminalWorld，一个通过自动逆向工程 8 万多个真实终端记录来构建高保真评估任务的数据引擎。该引擎生成了包含 1,530 个任务的基准，并提炼出 200 个任务的验证集。对 8 个模型和 6 个 Agent 的评估表明，当前系统在处理真实终端任务时表现不佳（最高通过率 62.5%），且该基准与现有基准相关性低，展示了其独特的真实评估价值与超强扩展性。
AI.keywords: TerminalWorld, Agent基准测试, 终端任务, 数据引擎, 逆向工程
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：通过逆向工程实际终端记录来自动生成评估任务，打破了传统人工设计基准的规模和时效性限制。
2. 实用性：基准涵盖了从日常操作到超过50步的复杂工作流，真实反映了开发者的实际工作场景。
3. 局限性：虽然有自动化引擎，但为了保证高质量仍需人工筛选（Verified子集仅200个任务），完全自动化的验证机制可能仍有优化空间。

title: SpaceDG: Benchmarking Spatial Intelligence under Visual Degradation
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress in spatial intelligence, yet existing spatial reasoning benchmarks largely assume pristine visual inputs and overlook the degradations that commonly occur in real-world deployment, such as motion blur, low light, adverse weather, lens distortion, and compression artifacts. This raises a fundamental question: how robust is the spatial intelligence of current MLLMs when visual observations are imperfect? To answer this question, we introduce SpaceDG, the first large-scale dataset for degradation-aware spatial understanding. It is constructed with a physically grounded degradation synthesis engine that embeds degradation formation process into 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) rendering, enabling realistic simulation of nine degradation types. The resulting dataset contains approximately 1M QA pairs from nearly 1,000 indoor scenes. We further introduce SpaceDG-Bench, an human-verified benchmark with 1,102 questions spanning 11 reasoning categories and 9 visual degradation types, yielding over 10K VQA instances. Evaluating 25 open- and closed-source MLLMs reveals that visual degradations consistently and substantially impair spatial reasoning, exposing a critical robustness gap. Finally, we show that finetuning on SpaceDG markedly improves degradation robustness and can even surpass human performance under degraded conditions without any performance drop on clean images, highlighting the promise of degradation-aware training for robust spatial intelligence.

AI.title_translation: SpaceDG：视觉退化下的空间智能基准测试
AI.tldr: 本文推出了首个评估多模态大模型在视觉退化下空间推理能力的数据集SpaceDG和基准SpaceDG-Bench，揭示了现有模型在不完美视觉输入下的鲁棒性缺陷，并证实退化感知微调能显著提升其鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）空间推理基准测试普遍假设输入图像是完美的，忽视了实际应用中常见的视觉退化（如模糊、弱光、畸变等），导致无法准确评估模型在现实复杂环境下的空间智能鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建了首个退化感知空间理解数据集 SpaceDG。该数据集采用基于物理原理的退化合成引擎，将退化过程嵌入到 3D 2D高斯泼溅（3DGS）渲染中，真实模拟了9种视觉退化类型（如运动模糊、低光照、恶劣天气等），包含约1M个问答对。并推出了经过人工验证的基准测试 SpaceDG-Bench，包含1,102个问题和超过10K个VQA实例，用于评估25种开源和闭源MLLM。
AI.result: 评估显示，视觉退化显著降低了25种主流MLLM的空间推理能力，暴露出明显的鲁棒性不足。然而，在SpaceDG数据集上进行微调能显著提升模型的鲁棒性，甚至使其在退化条件下的表现超越人类，且不会降低其在清晰图像上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 视觉退化严重阻碍了当前多模态大模型的空间推理能力，而通过退化感知数据集（如SpaceDG）进行微调是提升模型在现实不完美视觉观测下鲁棒性的一种极具前景且有效的方法。
AI.translation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在空间智能方面取得了快速进展，但现有的空间推理基准测试在很大程度上假设视觉输入是完美的，忽略了在现实世界部署中常见的退化，例如运动模糊、低光照、恶劣天气、镜头畸变和压缩伪影。这提出了一个根本性的问题：当视觉观测不完美时，当前MLLMs的空间智能鲁棒性如何？为了回答这个问题，我们引入了SpaceDG，这是首个用于退化感知空间理解的大规模数据集。它通过一个基于物理原理的退化合成引擎构建，该引擎将退化形成过程嵌入到3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）渲染中，从而能够逼真地模拟九种退化类型。生成的数据集包含来自近1000个室内场景的约100万个问答对。我们进一步引入了SpaceDG-Bench，这是一个经过人工验证的基准测试，包含1102个问题，跨越11个推理类别和9种视觉退化类型，产生了超过1万个视觉问答（VQA）实例。对25个开源和闭源MLLMs的评估表明，视觉退化一致且大幅度地削弱了空间推理能力，暴露出了关键的鲁棒性差距。最后，我们表明在SpaceDG上进行微调可以显著提高退化鲁棒性，甚至在退化条件下超越人类的表现，同时在清晰图像上不会出现任何性能下降，这突出了退化感知训练对于构建鲁棒空间智能的前景。
AI.summary: 本文针对多模态大语言模型在真实世界视觉退化下的空间推理能力，提出了首个大规模退化感知空间理解数据集SpaceDG及基准测试SpaceDG-Bench。该数据集利用3DGS渲染技术逼真模拟了9种视觉退化。实验表明，当前模型的空间推理极易受视觉退化影响，而通过SpaceDG进行微调能显著增强模型的退化鲁棒性，且不损害其在清晰图像上的表现。
AI.keywords: 空间智能, 视觉退化, 多模态大语言模型, 3D高斯泼溅, 鲁棒性基准
AI.comments: 该论文具有很强的创新性和实用价值。其创新之处在于首次将3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）渲染技术与基于物理的退化合成引擎相结合，能够逼真地模拟现实中的各种视觉缺陷。其重要性在于填补了当前多模态大模型在非理想视觉条件下空间推理能力评估的空白，对自动驾驶、机器人导航等实际应用场景具有极高的参考价值。局限性在于目前主要集中在室内场景，未来需要进一步扩展到更复杂的室外开放场景。

title: F-TIS: Harnessing Diverse Models in Collaborative GRPO
comments: Accepted to ICML 2026 Workshop Scalable Learning and Optimization for Efficient Multimodal AI Agents (SCALE)
summary: Reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO have seen great popularity in LLM post-training. In GRPO, models produce completions to a set of prompts, which are rewarded, and the policy is updated towards the relatively high reward completions. Due to the auto-regressive nature of models, the generation phase of such style of training can be extremely time consuming. As a solution, prior work has sought to distribute the inference step across many nodes, working parallel. These works assume primarily homogeneous models in the training in order to keep samples as close to on-policy as possible. This assumption may be impractical in decentralized systems, where parties with various computes and preferences may wish to collaborate on the same task. Thus, decentralized training requires an approach that can handle heterogeneous models - different models collaborating on the same tasks. However, this leads to highly off-policy samples presented during training, which prior work has identified that off-policy samples can hurt GRPO convergence. To enable heterogeneity, we propose Filtered Truncated Importance Sampling (F-TIS) - a GRPO-style training paradigm that can use off-policy samples to improve local model's learning. Our framework allows various models to collaborate in the same RL training run while being communication efficient. We extensively evaluate F-TIS in various heterogeneous setups and we show that it exhibits identical final model convergence to purely on-sample training. Furthermore, we observe in some setups better generalization on out-of-distribution tasks than on-policy training, increasing model's performance by up to 12\%.
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Workshop Scalable Learning and Optimization for Efficient Multimodal AI Agents (SCALE)

AI.title_translation: F-TIS：在协同GRPO中利用多样化模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出F-TIS框架，通过过滤截断重要性采样解决了去中心化GRPO训练中异构模型协作导致的离策收敛难题，在保证收敛的同时将分布外泛化性能提升了高达12%。
AI.motivation: 在LLM后训练中，GRPO等强化学习方法由于自回归生成的特性而极其耗时。虽然分布式并行推理可以缓解这一问题，但现有方法假设模型是同质的。在去中心化系统中，不同参与者拥有不同的计算资源和偏好，需要异构（不同）模型进行协作。然而，异构协作会产生高度离策的样本，从而严重损害GRPO的收敛性。
AI.method: 提出了过滤截断重要性采样（Filtered Truncated Importance Sampling, F-TIS）框架。这是一种新型的GRPO风格训练范式，能够利用离策（off-policy）样本来改进本地模型的学习，允许不同的模型在同一个强化学习训练运行中进行高效协作，同时保持通信效率。
AI.result: 在多种异构设置下的评估表明，F-TIS展现出与纯同策（on-policy）训练完全相同的最终模型收敛性。此外，在某些设置中，F-TIS在分布外（OOD）任务上表现出比同策训练更好的泛化能力，使模型性能提升了多达12%。
AI.conclusion: F-TIS成功克服了异构模型在去中心化协作GRPO训练中由于离策样本导致的收敛问题。它不仅实现了与纯同策训练相当的收敛效果，还在部分场景下显著提升了模型的泛化性能。
AI.translation: 诸如GRPO（群组相对策略优化）之类的强化学习方法在LLM（大语言模型）后训练中受到了极大的欢迎。在GRPO中，模型针对一组提示词生成补全内容并获得奖励，随后策略会向奖励相对较高的补全内容进行更新。由于模型的自回归特性，这种训练方式的生成阶段可能会极其耗时。为了解决这一问题，先前的研究试图将推理步骤分发到多个节点上进行并行工作。这些研究在训练中主要假设模型是同质的，以便使样本尽可能接近同策（on-policy）。在去中心化系统中，这种假设可能是极不切实际的，因为拥有不同计算资源和偏好的各方可能希望在同一个任务上进行协作。因此，去中心化训练需要一种能够处理异构模型（即不同模型在相同任务上进行协作）的方法。然而，这会导致在训练过程中出现高度偏离策略（off-policy）的样本，而先前的研究已经指出，离策样本会损害GRPO的收敛性。为了实现异构性，我们提出了过滤截断重要性采样（F-TIS）——一种可以使用离策样本来改进本地模型学习的GRPO风格训练范式。我们的框架允许各种模型在同一个强化学习训练运行中进行协作，同时具有较高的通信效率。我们在各种异构设置中对F-TIS进行了广泛的评估，结果表明它展现出了与纯同策训练完全相同的最终模型收敛性。此外，在某些设置中，我们观察到它在分布外（OOD）任务上比同策训练具有更好的泛化能力，将模型的性能提升了多达12%。
AI.summary: 本文针对去中心化强化学习（GRPO）中多异构模型协作训练面临的离策样本导致收敛困难的问题，提出了F-TIS（过滤截断重要性采样）框架。该框架允许不同规格的模型高效协同训练并保持通信效率。实验表明，F-TIS在保证与同策训练相同收敛性的同时，在分布外任务上展现出更佳的泛化表现，性能提升高达12%。
AI.keywords: GRPO, 异构模型, 离策学习, 过滤截断重要性采样 (F-TIS), 去中心化训练
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于首次将重要性采样（F-TIS）引入到GRPO框架中，成功解决了去中心化场景下异构模型联合训练所导致的严重离策（off-policy）偏差问题。这一工作对于推动去中心化、跨机构的LLM协作强化学习具有重要意义，降低了对同质化算力集群的依赖。局限性在于摘要中未详细量化其通信开销的具体表现，且对于极端异构环境（如模型规模差异极大）下的表现尚待更广泛的验证。

title: Segment Anything with Motion, Geometry, and Semantic Adaptation for Complex Nonlinear Visual Object Tracking
summary: Traditional visual object tracking (VOT) methods typically rely on task-specific supervised training, limiting their generalization to unseen objects and challenging scenarios with distractors, occlusion, and nonlinear motion. Recent vision foundation models, exemplified by SAM 2, learn strong video understanding priors from large-scale pretraining and offer a promising foundation for building more robust and generalizable trackers. However, directly applying SAM 2 to VOT remains suboptimal, as it does not explicitly model target motion dynamics or enforce geometric and semantic consistency across frames, both of which are essential for reliable tracking. To address this issue, we propose SAMOSA, a new tracking framework that adapts SAM 2 to complex VOT scenarios by explicitly leveraging motion, geometry, and semantic cues. Specifically, we introduce a lightweight nonlinear motion predictor to model target dynamics and guide mask selection as well as memory filtering. We further exploit semantic cues to detect target shifts and recover from tracking failures, while geometric cues are incorporated as structural constraints to improve tracking stability. In this way, SAMOSA bridges the gap between the implicit video understanding prior of SAM 2 and explicit tracking-oriented modeling. Extensive experiments show that SAMOSA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art SAM 2--based approaches on general benchmarks, demonstrates stronger generalization than supervised VOT methods, and achieves substantial gains on anti-UAV datasets, which typify complex nonlinear motion scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/DurYi/SAMOSA.

AI.title_translation: 基于运动、几何和语义自适应的Segment Anything在复杂非线性视觉目标跟踪中的应用
AI.tldr: 本文提出SAMOSA框架，通过引入轻量级非线性运动预测、语义自适应和几何约束，克服了SAM 2在复杂非线性视觉目标跟踪中缺乏显式动力学建模的不足。
AI.motivation: 传统的监督视觉目标跟踪（VOT）方法泛化性不足；而直接应用大模型SAM 2进行跟踪时，由于缺乏对目标运动动力学的显式建模以及帧间几何/语义一致性的约束，在面对复杂非线性运动和干扰时效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出SAMOSA框架，通过显式利用三种线索适配SAM 2：1) 引入轻量级非线性运动预测器建模目标动力学，指导掩膜选择与记忆过滤；2) 利用语义线索检测目标偏移并实现失效恢复；3) 引入几何线索作为结构约束以提升跟踪稳定性。
AI.result: 在通用基准上，SAMOSA持续超越了最先进的基于SAM 2的方法，表现出比传统监督式VOT方法更强的泛化能力，并在具有复杂非线性运动特征的反无人机（anti-UAV）数据集上取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: SAMOSA成功弥合了SAM 2的隐式视频先验与显式跟踪建模之间的差距，为复杂非线性场景下的强泛化视觉目标跟踪提供了一种高效、鲁棒的解决方案。
AI.translation: 传统的视觉目标跟踪（VOT）方法通常依赖于特定任务的监督训练，这限制了它们对未见目标以及包含干扰、遮挡和非线性运动等挑战性场景的泛化能力。最近的视觉基础模型（以SAM 2为代表）通过大规模预训练学习到了强大的视频理解先验，为构建更鲁棒、更具泛化性的跟踪器提供了充满前景的基础。然而，将SAM 2直接应用于VOT仍非最优，因为它没有显式地建模目标运动动力学，也没有在帧间强制执行几何和语义一致性，而这两者对于可靠的跟踪至关重要。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SAMOSA，这是一种新的跟踪框架，它通过显式地利用运动、几何和语义线索，使SAM 2能够适应复杂的VOT场景。具体而言，我们引入了一个轻量级的非线性运动预测器来建模目标动力学，并指导掩膜选择以及记忆过滤。我们进一步利用语义线索来检测目标偏移并从跟踪失败中恢复，同时将几何线索作为结构约束引入，以提高跟踪稳定性。通过这种方式，SAMOSA弥合了SAM 2的隐式视频理解先验与显式面向跟踪建模之间的差距。大量实验表明，SAMOSA在通用基准上持续超越了最先进的基于SAM 2的方法，展示了比监督式VOT方法更强的泛化能力，并在代表复杂非线性运动场景的反无人机（anti-UAV）数据集上取得了实质性的提升。我们的代码开源在 https://github.com/DurYi/SAMOSA 。
AI.summary: 本文针对复杂非线性视觉目标跟踪问题，提出了SAMOSA框架。该框架通过在预训练大模型SAM 2的基础上，显式融入轻量级非线性运动预测、语义偏移检测与几何结构约束，克服了基础模型直接用于跟踪时缺乏显式动力学和一致性建模的缺陷，显著提升了复杂场景和未见目标下的跟踪精度与泛化性能。
AI.keywords: 视觉目标跟踪, SAM 2, 非线性运动预测, 语义自适应, 几何约束
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将基础大模型（SAM 2）的强视频理解先验与传统跟踪中不可或缺的运动、几何和语义物理约束进行了有机结合。通过引入轻量级模块，成功弥补了SAM 2在处理复杂非线性运动和目标漂移时的不足，特别是在反无人机（anti-UAV）等极具挑战性的场景中表现出极强的实用价值。局限性方面，摘要未详细说明引入这些自适应模块后对实时运行速度（FPS）的具体影响。

title: Dynamic Hypergraph Representation Learning for Multivariate Time Series without Prior Knowledge
summary: Hypergraphs have the capacity to capture higher-dimensional relationships among entities across various domains, making them a subject of growing interest within the research community for understanding the structure and dynamics of complex systems. However, a key challenge is the derivation of hypergraph representations from time series data in situations where the structure of the hypergraph is limited or absent. In this study, we propose a model that constructs a dynamic hypergraph representation for multivariate time series without relying on prior knowledge of the data. This is achieved by applying community detection to the time series and transforming the resulting communities, obtained through an attention mechanism, into a hypergraph using a clique-based technique. Hypergraph representations are derived from different time series datasets, and the resulting hypergraphs are then used by a Dynamic Hypergraph Attention Convolution Network (DHACN) for multivariate time series predictions. This research advances the field of hypergraph representation by introducing a novel approach that is better suited to uncover high-order relationships without prior knowledge.

AI.title_translation: 无先验知识的多变量时间序列动态超图表示学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需先验知识的多变量时间序列动态超图表示学习方法，通过社区检测和注意力机制构建动态超图，并利用DHACN网络进行高效预测。
AI.motivation: 超图在捕捉实体间高维关系方面具有优势，但在缺乏或完全没有预定义超图结构的多变量时间序列数据中，如何有效推导出超图表示是一个关键挑战。因此，研究旨在开发一种无需依赖先验知识即可动态构建超图表示的方法。
AI.method: 该方法首先对时间序列进行社区检测，接着通过注意力机制获取社区划分，并利用基于团（clique-based）的技术将这些社区转化为超图表示。最终，将生成的动态超图输入到动态超图注意力卷积网络（DHACN）中，用于多变量时间序列的预测任务。
AI.result: 成功从不同的时间序列数据集中推导出动态超图表示，并利用动态超图注意力卷积网络（DHACN）实现了多变量时间序列预测（具体量化预测结果在摘要中未提及）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功推出了一种无需先验知识即可构建动态超图的新方法，并将其应用于多变量时间序列预测，从而有效推动了超图表示学习在处理复杂高阶关系方面的发展。
AI.translation: 超图具有捕获各个领域实体之间更高维关系的能力，这使得它们在研究界中对于理解复杂系统的结构和动力学越来越受到关注。然而，一个关键挑战是在超图结构受限或缺失的情况下，如何从时间序列数据中推导出超图表示。在本研究中，我们提出了一种模型，该模型在不依赖数据先验知识的情况下，为多变量时间序列构建动态超图表示。这是通过对时间序列应用社区检测，并将通过注意力机制获得的生成社区，利用基于团的技术转换为超图来实现的。超图表示是从不同的时间序列数据集中推导出来的，然后将生成的超图用于动态超图注意力卷积网络（DHACN）以进行多变量时间序列预测。本研究通过引入一种更适合在无先验知识下揭示高阶关系的新方法，推进了超图表示领域的发展。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对无先验知识的多变量时间序列的动态超图表示学习模型。该模型通过社区检测和注意力机制识别时间序列中的关联群组，并采用基于团的技术将其转化为动态超图，最后利用动态超图注意力卷积网络（DHACN）进行时间序列预测，从而在无先验结构的情况下有效捕获了系统的高阶动态关系。
AI.keywords: 动态超图, 多变量时间序列, 社区检测, 表示学习, 注意力机制
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种无需先验知识、能从多变量时间序列中动态构建超图的方法，解决了传统超图方法依赖预定义拓扑结构的局限。其重要性在于通过社区检测与注意力机制的结合，为捕捉复杂系统中的高阶动态关系提供了新思路。局限性在于摘要中未给出具体的实验数据集表现及与现有基线模型的对比结果，且对于动态超图构建的计算复杂度未作说明。

title: Scene Abstraction for Lexical Semantics: Structured Representations of Situated Meaning
summary: Coffee and tea share many properties, yet they evoke strikingly different situations, atmospheres, and affective associations. These situated dimensions of word meaning are real and systematic, but they remain implicit in most computational representations of lexical meaning. We propose Scene Abstraction, a framework for constructing structured representations of the interpretive scenes that words participate in across usage contexts. Each scene consists of a Contextual Scene (Events, Entities, Setting) and an expression-centered Expression Profile (Engaged events, Generalizable properties, Evoked emotions), operationalized through few-shot prompting of a large language model. Our contributions are three-fold: (1) a structured representation framework for situated lexical meaning; (2) COCA-Scenes, a dataset of 520 usage instances across 26 keywords for distinct scene identification; and (3) empirical evidence from two experiments suggesting that scenes are reliably identifiable across human observers (82.4% accuracy, +11.8 pp over text-only embeddings) and that our scene profiles more closely align with human interpretation of words in context than ATOMIC-based alternatives (86.4% preference across three semantic dimensions).

AI.title_translation: 词汇语义学的场景抽象：情境意义的结构化表示
AI.tldr: 本文提出“场景抽象”框架，利用大语言模型提取词汇在语境中的结构化情境与情感表示，实验表明该方法在场景识别和符合人类理解方面显著优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管词汇（如咖啡和茶）在现实中能唤起截然不同的情境、氛围和情感联想，但这些丰富的情境维度在大多数现有的计算词汇语义表示中仍然是隐性的，缺乏系统的结构化呈现。
AI.method: 提出了“场景抽象”（Scene Abstraction）框架，通过大语言模型（LLM）的少样本提示（few-shot prompting）来构建词汇在具体语境中的结构化场景表示。每个场景包含“上下文场景”（Events, Entities, Setting）和“表达谱”（Engaged events, Generalizable properties, Evoked emotions）两部分。此外，构建了包含520个使用实例的数据集 COCA-Scenes。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：（1）人类观察者能够高度一致地识别出这些场景（准确率达82.4%，比仅文本嵌入高出11.8个百分点）；（2）在三个语义维度上，该框架生成的场景谱比基于ATOMIC的替代方案更符合人类对语境中词汇的理解（人类偏好度达86.4%）。
AI.conclusion: 场景抽象框架能够有效且可靠地捕捉和表示词汇的结构化情境意义，相比传统的仅文本嵌入和基于ATOMIC的替代方案，该框架生成的场景谱更贴近人类在实际语境中对词汇的理解。
AI.translation: 咖啡和茶有很多共同的属性，但它们能唤起截然不同的情境、氛围和情感联想。词汇意义的这些情境维度是真实且系统化的，但在大多数词汇意义的计算表示中，它们仍然是隐性的。我们提出了“场景抽象”（Scene Abstraction），这是一个用于构建词汇在不同使用语境中所参与的解释性场景的结构化表示的框架。每个场景由上下文场景（事件、实体、背景）和以表达为中心的表达谱（参与的事件、可推广的属性、唤起的情感）组成，通过大语言模型的少样本提示来实现。我们的贡献有三点：（1）一个用于情境词汇意义的结构化表示框架；（2）COCA-Scenes，一个包含26个关键词、520个使用实例的数据集，用于不同场景的识别；（3）两项实验的经验证据表明，场景在人类观察者之间具有可靠的可识别性（准确率为82.4%，比仅文本嵌入高出11.8个百分点），并且在三个语义维度上，我们的场景谱比基于ATOMIC的替代方案更符合人类在语境中对词汇的解释（偏好度达86.4%）。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有计算词汇语义表示无法有效捕捉词汇情境信息的缺陷，提出了“场景抽象”框架。该框架利用大语言模型将词汇在上下文中的情境结构化为上下文场景和表达谱。通过引入COCA-Scenes数据集和两项实证实验，证明了该框架在场景识别的可靠性以及与人类理解的契合度上均显著优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 场景抽象, 词汇语义学, 情境意义, 结构化表示, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 本论文的创新点在于将词汇语义学与情境认知相结合，提出了一种利用大语言模型（LLM）进行少样本提示来提取结构化情境意义的新框架。它弥补了传统词向量或文本嵌入在捕捉词汇背后微妙的氛围、情感和具体场景（如“咖啡”与“茶”的差异）方面的不足。通过构建高质量的COCA-Scenes数据集并进行细致的人类评估，证明了该方法的有效性，为自然语言处理中的语义表示提供了新的视角。

title: One prompt is not enough: Instruction Sensitivity Undermines Embedding Model Evaluation
summary: Instruction embedding models have become common among state-of-the-art models, however are evaluated using a single prompt per task. The single-point evaluation ignores a main problem of the instruction-based approach namely: sensitivity to the phrasing of the instruction. We present an empirical study of prompt sensitivity across 6 embedding models, 11 datasets, and 15 task-specific prompts per dataset, a total of 990. We show that reported scores misrepresent the distribution of scores over plausible prompts. The default prompt can both systematically understate or overstate performance. Furthermore, we show that the leaderboard ranking is not robust to prompt selection: by choosing prompts favorably, any model in our study can be promoted to first place. Our findings suggest that single-prompt evaluation is insufficient for instruction-tuned embedding models and that benchmarks should incorporate prompt robustness, either by evaluating over multiple prompts or by reporting sensitivity alongside point estimates.

AI.title_translation: 单提示词远远不够：指令敏感性削弱了嵌入模型的评估
AI.tldr: 研究表明指令嵌入模型对提示词措辞高度敏感，现有的单提示词评估方法无法准确反映模型性能，甚至会导致排行榜排名失真。
AI.motivation: 尽管指令嵌入模型已成为主流，但目前对它们的评估通常每个任务仅使用单个提示词。这种单点评估忽略了指令方法的一个核心问题：模型性能对提示词具体措辞的高度敏感性。
AI.method: 对6个嵌入模型、11个数据集以及每个数据集15个特定任务的提示词（共计990个实验配置）进行了关于提示词敏感性的系统性实证研究。
AI.result: 1. 报告的单点分数无法真实反映在合理提示词集合上的性能分布；2. 默认提示词可能会系统性地低估或高估模型的实际性能；3. 排行榜排名对提示词的选择极不鲁棒，通过刻意选择有利的提示词，研究中的任何一个模型都可以被提升至第一名。
AI.conclusion: 单提示词评估对于指令微调的嵌入模型而言是不足的。未来的基准测试应当将提示词鲁棒性纳入评估标准，可以通过在多个提示词上进行综合评估，或者在报告性能点估计的同时提供敏感性指标。
AI.translation: 指令嵌入模型在最先进的模型中已变得非常普遍，然而，它们在评估时每个任务仅使用单个提示词。这种单点评估忽略了基于指令的方法的一个主要问题：对提示词措辞的敏感性。我们对6个嵌入模型、11个数据集以及每个数据集15个特定任务的提示词（共计990个组合）进行了关于提示词敏感性的实证研究。我们表明，报告的分数歪曲了在合理提示词上的分数分布。默认提示词既可以系统性地低估，也可以高估性能。此外，我们表明排行榜排名对提示词的选择并不鲁棒：通过有利地选择提示词，我们研究中的任何模型都可以被提升到第一名。我们的研究结果表明，单提示词评估对于指令微调的嵌入模型是不够的，基准测试应该纳入提示词鲁棒性，要么通过在多个提示词上进行评估，要么在报告点估计的同时报告敏感性。
AI.summary: 本文针对指令嵌入模型评估中常用的“单任务单提示词”方法提出了质疑。通过对多个模型和数据集的大规模实证研究，作者证实了模型性能对提示词措辞具有极高的敏感性，现有的单提示词评估和排行榜排名极易受到提示词选择的影响。为此，作者建议基准测试应引入提示词鲁棒性评估。
AI.keywords: 指令嵌入模型, 提示词敏感性, 模型评估, 鲁棒性, 基准测试
AI.comments: 本研究具有重要的现实意义，揭示了当前指令嵌入模型评估中普遍存在的“单提示词偏差”问题。其创新之处在于通过大规模的实证研究（990个提示词-模型-数据集组合）量化了这种敏感性对排行榜排名的颠覆性影响。局限性在于，摘要中未深入探讨导致这种敏感性的深层机制，也未提出如何自动构建鲁棒提示词的具体算法方案。

title: Case-Aware Medical Image Classification with Multimodal Knowledge Graphs and Reliability-Guided Refinement
summary: Deep learning has brought significant progress to medical image classification, yet most existing methods still rely on isolated visual evidence and cannot effectively leverage similar cases or external knowledge. In clinical practice, diagnosis is typically supported by historical similar cases and their associated symptoms. To simulate this diagnostic process, we propose a framework that performs case-aware reasoning using multimodal knowledge graphs for explainable medical image diagnosis. Given an input image, our method constructs a multimodal knowledge graph from adaptively retrieved similar cases, enabling more effective utilization of related samples. We further introduce a knowledge propagation and injection mechanism, where an image-centric Graph Attention Network propagates knowledge semantics to obtain case-based features, followed by a bidirectional cross-modal attention mechanism that injects these features into visual representations for cross-modal alignment. To mitigate noisy retrieval, we design a confidence-calibrated decision refinement scheme that estimates the reliability of each retrieved case by jointly considering prediction confidence and sample similarity, adaptively adjusting its contribution to the final prediction and providing interpretable case-level evidence. Extensive experiments on multiple medical imaging datasets show that our approach consistently outperforms strong baselines, and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of each component. The source code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MKG-CARE-8B7B.

AI.title_translation: 基于多模态知识图谱与可靠性引导精炼的案例感知医学图像分类
AI.tldr: 提出了一种利用多模态知识图谱整合相似病例的医学图像分类框架，通过可靠性评估过滤噪声，实现了更准确且可解释的诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像分类方法多依赖单一视觉证据，缺乏对相似病例和外部临床知识的有效利用，难以模拟医生基于历史经验进行诊断的临床过程。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于多模态知识图谱的案例感知推理框架。首先，根据输入图像检索相似病例并构建知识图谱；其次，利用以图像为中心的图注意力网络进行知识传播，并通过双向跨模态注意力机制将特征注入视觉表示；最后，设计了置信度校准的决策精炼方案，通过评估检索病例的可靠性来优化最终预测。
AI.result: 在多个医学影像数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法在分类性能上显著优于现有主流基准模型，且消融实验证明了所提各模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的框架通过多模态知识图谱与可靠性评估，成功实现了病理性特征的精准推理，在多个医学图像数据集上验证了其优越性能，证明了整合病例关联与外部知识对诊断任务的价值。
AI.translation: 深度学习在医学图像分类方面取得了显著进展，但大多数现有方法仍依赖于孤立的视觉证据，无法有效利用相似病例或外部知识。在临床实践中，诊断通常由历史相似病例及其相关症状支持。为了模拟这一诊断过程，我们提出了一个框架，利用多模态知识图谱进行案例感知推理，以实现可解释的医学图像诊断。给定输入图像，我们的方法从自适应检索的相似病例中构建多模态知识图谱，从而更有效地利用相关样本。我们进一步引入了知识传播和注入机制，其中以图像为中心的图注意力网络传播知识语义以获得基于案例的特征，随后通过双向跨模态注意力机制将这些特征注入视觉表示以实现跨模态对齐。为了减轻检索噪声，我们设计了一种置信度校准的决策精炼方案，通过综合考虑预测置信度和样本相似度来估计每个检索病例的可靠性，自适应调整其对最终预测的贡献，并提供可解释的病例级证据。在多个医学影像数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法始终优于强基线模型，消融研究验证了每个组件的有效性。源代码已在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MKG-CARE-8B7B 公开。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种案例感知的医学图像分类框架，通过构建多模态知识图谱整合相似病例与临床知识，利用图注意力网络传播语义，并引入可靠性引导的决策精炼机制来过滤噪声，从而显著提升了诊断的准确性与可解释性。
AI.keywords: 医学图像分类, 多模态知识图谱, 案例感知推理, 可解释性, 决策精炼
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将多模态知识图谱引入医学图像分类，模拟了临床诊断中参考相似病例的思维过程。通过引入可靠性引导的精炼机制，有效解决了检索噪声问题，增强了模型的可解释性，是提升医学AI诊断临床适用性的重要尝试。

title: MOTOR: A Multimodal Dataset for Two-Wheeler Rider Behavior Understanding
summary: Two-wheelers account for a disproportionately high share of road fatalities in the Global South. Research on two-wheeler rider behavior, however, lags far behind four-wheelers, where multimodal datasets have driven major advances in Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS). To address this gap, we present the MOtorized TwO-wheeler Rider (MOTOR) dataset, the first large-scale, multi-view, multimodal resource dedicated to two-wheelers in dense, unstructured traffic. MOTOR comprises 1,629 sequences (25+ hours of video data) collected from 16 riders and integrates synchronized front, rear, and helmet videos, rider eye-gaze from wearable trackers, on-road audio, and telemetry (GPS, accelerometer, gyroscope). Rich annotations capture traffic context, rider state, 12 riding maneuvers spanning conventional and unconventional behaviors, and legality labels (Legal, Illegal, Unspecified). We benchmark rider behavior recognition and maneuver legality classification using state-of-the-art video action recognition backbones (CNN and Transformer-based), extended with multimodal fusion, and find that combining RGB, gaze, and telemetry consistently yields the best performance. MOTOR thus provides a unique foundation for advancing safety-critical understanding of two-wheeler riding. It offers the research community a benchmark to develop and evaluate models for behavior analysis, legality-aware prediction, and intelligent transportation systems. Dataset and code is available at https: //varuniiith.github.io/MOTOR-Dataset/

AI.title_translation: 用于理解两轮车骑行者行为的多模态数据集：MOTOR
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了MOTOR数据集，一个大规模、多视角、多模态的数据集，用于解决两轮车骑行者行为理解的研究不足问题，旨在推动两轮车安全领域的发展。
AI.motivation: 两轮车事故死亡率高，但相关研究滞后于四轮车，缺乏多模态数据集来推动高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）的发展。
AI.method: 创建了一个名为MOTOR（MOtorized TwO-wheeler Rider）的大规模、多视角、多模态数据集，包含1629个序列（超过25小时视频），集成了前、后、头盔视角视频、骑行者注视点、道路音频和遥测数据。对交通环境、骑行者状态、12种骑行操作（包括非常规行为）和合法性进行了标注。并使用CNN和Transformer等模型对骑行者行为识别和操作合法性分类进行了基准测试。
AI.result: 结合RGB、注视点和遥测数据能够获得最佳性能，表明多模态融合在两轮车骑行者行为理解方面具有优势。
AI.conclusion: MOTOR数据集为两轮车安全研究提供了基础，能够用于开发和评估行为分析、合法性感知预测和智能交通系统模型。
AI.translation: 全球南方国家（Global South）的道路死亡事故中，两轮车占有不成比例的高比例。然而，与四轮车相比，对两轮车骑行者行为的研究远远落后，而四轮车的多模态数据集已推动了高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）的重大进展。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了MOtorized TwO-wheeler Rider（MOTOR）数据集，这是第一个专门针对稠密、非结构化交通中的两轮车的大规模、多视角、多模态资源。MOTOR包含1,629个序列（超过25小时的视频数据），由16名骑行者收集，并集成了同步的前、后和头盔视频、来自可穿戴追踪器的骑行者眼动追踪、路面音频和遥测数据（GPS、加速度计、陀螺仪）。丰富的注释捕捉了交通环境、骑行者状态、跨越常规和非常规行为的12种骑行操作以及合法性标签（合法、非法、未指定）。我们使用最先进的视频动作识别骨干网络（CNN和基于Transformer的），通过多模态融合进行扩展，对骑行者行为识别和操作合法性分类进行了基准测试，发现结合RGB、眼动追踪和遥测数据始终能产生最佳性能。因此，MOTOR为推进对两轮车骑行至关重要的安全理解提供了独特的基石。它为研究界提供了一个基准，用于开发和评估行为分析、合法性感知预测和智能交通系统的模型。数据集和代码可在https://varuniiith.github.io/MOTOR-Dataset/获取。
AI.summary: 该研究介绍了MOTOR数据集，一个用于两轮车骑行者行为理解的大规模多模态数据集。该数据集包含多视角视频、眼动追踪、音频和遥测数据，并对交通环境、骑行者状态和骑行行为进行了详细标注。研究发现，多模态融合方法在行为识别和合法性分类方面表现最佳，为开发更安全的两轮车智能交通系统奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 两轮车行为理解, 多模态数据集, 智能交通系统, 骑行者安全, 行为识别
AI.comments: 该研究填补了在两轮车骑行者行为理解领域的重要空白，尤其是在全球南方国家。MOTOR数据集的全面性和多模态特性为未来研究提供了坚实的基础。然而，数据集的收集环境（稠密、非结构化交通）可能限制了其在其他交通场景下的直接适用性。此外，对于非常规行为的定义和标注，可以进一步探讨其主观性和潜在的偏差。

title: FashionLens: Toward Versatile Fashion Image Retrieval via Task-Adaptive Learning
summary: Fashion image retrieval is a cornerstone of modern e-commerce systems. A unified framework that supports diverse query formats and search intentions is highly desired in practice. However, existing approaches focus on narrow retrieval tasks and do not fully capture such diversity. Therefore, in this work, we aim to develop a unified framework capable of handling diverse realistic fashion retrieval scenarios, achieving truly versatile fashion image retrieval. To establish a data foundation, we first introduce U-FIRE, a comprehensive benchmark that consolidates fragmented fashion datasets into a unified collection, supplemented by two manually curated datasets for testing generalization. Building upon this, we propose FashionLens, a unified framework based on Multimodal Large Language Models. To handle divergent matching objectives, we design a Proposal-Guided Spherical Query Calibrator that dynamically shifts query representations into task-aligned metric spaces via adaptive spherical linear interpolation. Additionally, to mitigate the optimization imbalance caused by varying task complexities and data scales, we develop a Gradient-Guided Adaptive Sampling strategy that automatically re-weights tasks based on realtime learning difficulty and the data scale prior. Experiments on U-FIRE show that FashionLens achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse retrieval scenarios and generalizes robustly to unseen tasks. The data and code are publicly released at https://github.com/haokunwen/FashionLens.

title: ImplicitTerrainV2: Wavelet-Guided Spatially Adaptive Neural Terrain Representation
summary: Digital elevation models (DEMs) underpin terrain analysis in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), but in their common raster form, they rely on interpolation for off-grid sampling and finite-difference operators for derivative-based analysis. Implicit neural representations (INRs) offer a continuous alternative, but prior terrain INRs lack explicit frequency control, neglect the gradient structure of terrain, and remain too large and costly to train for practical deployment. We present ImplicitTerrainV2, which advances terrain INRs toward a compact, efficient neural terrain data format by combining a spectral control mechanism with wavelet-guided spatial adaptivity, derivative-aware supervision, and post-training model compression. At its core, a wavelet complexity field (WCF) derives spatially-adaptive frequency masks from analytically computed wavelet coefficients, localizing high-frequency capacity to complex terrain regions. The same field guides complexity-aware adaptive sampling that concentrates training in high-complexity regions, while gradient matching applies extra supervision to enforce the smooth manifold structure of terrain DEMs for improved derivative fidelity. Post-training mixed-precision quantization and entropy coding reduce storage to 1.23 bpp with a 0.28 dB PSNR drop. On 50 Swiss terrain tiles, ImplicitTerrainV2 reaches 66.25 dB end-to-end PSNR, improving over the prior work by 5.70 dB while using 3.2x fewer parameters and training in 55 s per tile on a single GPU. Our compressed neural format is competitive with several established DEM codecs in rate-distortion performance, while additionally supporting off-grid point queries, closed-form derivative evaluation, and resolution-independent reconstruction, which may benefit many downstream GIS applications.

title: Neural Flow Operators can Approximate any Operator: Abstract Frameworks and Universal Approcimations
summary: We introduce an abstract neural flow framework for neural networks and neural operators. The framework contains two continuous-depth models, namely neural flows with composition and separation structures, and covers both finite-dimensional function approximation and infinite-dimensional operator approximation. We prove well-posedness and universal approximation properties for the corresponding neural flows, including, to the best of our knowledge, the first universal approximation result for flow-based models between infinite-dimensional spaces. We also obtain universal approximation results for convolutional neural flow models. Through suitable time discretizations, the composition structure recovers ResNet-type architectures, while the separation structure, via a splitting-based discretization, yields plain architectures. This gives a unified flow-based route to both residual and plain architectures for neural networks and neural operators with fully connected or convolutional linear layers.

title: GeoWeaver: Grounding Visual Tokens with Geometric Evidence before Scene Reasoning
summary: Spatio-temporal reasoning in vision-language models requires visual representations that preserve physical geometry rather than merely semantic appearance. Recent multimodal models incorporate geometric information through structural branches, 3D-aware supervision, reasoning-stage fusion, or long-horizon memory. While these approaches demonstrate the importance of geometry for spatial intelligence, they typically treat geometric cues as a shared signal across all visual tokens. We note that this overlooks a finer-grained challenge: different visual tokens require different geometric evidence depending on their spatial roles. To address this limitation, we introduce GeoWeaver, a pre-reasoning geometric grounding framework that treats geometry as a representational prerequisite for spatio-temporal reasoning. GeoWeaver constructs a multi-level geometry bank from a frozen geometry encoder and performs token-adaptive geometric evidence allocation, enabling each visual token to retrieve the most relevant geometric abstractions. The selected evidence is incorporated into visual tokens via a residual grounding operation prior to language modeling, yielding geometry-grounded representations for downstream reasoning. Extensive evaluations on spatial reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that GeoWeaver consistently enhances geometry-aware reasoning while retaining general multimodal capabilities. This indicates that geometric information yields the greatest benefit not as a late-fusion auxiliary signal but as a fundamental prerequisite that shapes the representational foundation on which large language models perform reasoning. All source code and models will be released at https://github.com/yahooo-m/GeoWeaver .

title: Regret-Based $(ε,δ)$-optimal Stopping Criteria for Bayesian Optimization
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a widely used iterative black-box optimization method that utilizes Gaussian process (GP) surrogate models. In practice, BO is typically terminated after a fixed evaluation budget is exhausted, which can incur unnecessary cost and provides no optimality guarantee on solution quality. Recent research in developing a practical stopping criterion has made empirical progress, yet a theoretically sound stopping criterion remains a work in progress. In this work, we present provably tighter instantaneous regret bounds for GP upper confidence bound (GP-UCB) at any given iteration. Then, we propose stopping criteria for GP-UCB based on this tighter bound that ensures an $ε$-optimal solution with high probability $1-δ$ upon termination. Numerical experiments are performed to validate and demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our stopping criteria.

title: Cell Phantom Video Generation in Elliptical Fourier Descriptor Domain
comments: 6 pages, Accepted at the International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP) 2026
summary: Training Deep Neural Networks for tracking individual cells in biomedical videos requires a large amount of annotated data. The annotation of videos for cell tracking is very time consuming and often requires domain expertise; this explains the limited availability of public annotated data to address important medical problems like tissue repair or cancer treatment. Generating synthetic videos along with their Ground Truth annotations is a promising solution that relies, as a foundational first step, on the synthesis of single cell annotations (or phantoms). Phantoms need to be time consistent, as they have to replicate biological processes that are specific to the cell types. In this work, we propose a novel framework for generating videos of cell phantoms in the Elliptical Fourier Descriptors (EFDs) domain, a compact and geometrically interpretable representation for 2D closed contours. We represent the cell phantom evolution as a multivariate time series of EFD coefficients, introducing a strong prior for cell morphology and enabling the efficient generation of sequences that evolve coherently in time. Our experimental validation proves that modelling the temporal evolution in EFD space enables the generation of biologically plausible phantom videos. Our method can be used in generative pipelines for synthesizing annotated data for cell tracking, thus strongly mitigating the annotation effort for creating new datasets. Our code is available for download here: https://github.com/FrancescoBenedetto99/efd-cell-video-gen.
comment: 6 pages, Accepted at the International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP) 2026

title: SynAE: A Framework for Measuring the Quality of Synthetic Data for Tool-Calling Agent Evaluations
summary: Today, tool-calling agents are commonly evaluated or tested on static datasets of execution traces, including input commands, agent responses, and associated tool calls. However, internal production datasets are often insufficient or unusable for testing; for example, they may contain sensitive or proprietary data, or they may be too sparse to support comprehensive testing (especially pre-deployment). In these settings, practitioners are increasingly replacing or augmenting real datasets with synthetic ones for evaluation purposes. A key challenge is quantifying the relation between these synthetic datasets and the real data. We introduce SynAE, an evaluation framework for assessing how well synthetic benchmarks for multi-turn, tool-calling agents replicate and augment the characteristics of real data trajectories. SynAE assesses the validity, fidelity, and diversity of synthetic data across four metric categories: (i) task instructions and intermediate responses, (ii) tool calls, (iii) final outputs, and (iv) downstream evaluation. We evaluate SynAE using recent agent benchmarks and test common synthetic data failure modes via realistic and controlled generation schemes. SynAE detects fine-grained variations in data validity, fidelity and diversity, and shows that no single metric is sufficient to fully characterize synthetic data quality, motivating a multi-axis evaluation of synthetic data for agent testing. A demo of SynAE is available at https://synae-2026-synae-demo.static.hf.space/index.html, with code at https://github.com/wsqwsq/SynAE.

title: GraphFlow: A Graph-Based Workflow Management for Efficient LLM-Agent Serving
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents demonstrate strong reasoning and execution capabilities on complex tasks when guided by structured instructions, commonly referred to as workflows. However, existing workflow-assisted agent serving systems typically rely on predefined templates and shallow matching mechanisms, which limit their ability to capture deep semantic relationships and generalize to previously unseen tasks. To address these limitations, we propose a new workflow management paradigm that represents workflows using a unified graph, termed wGraph, where each node corresponds to an atomic operation. wGraph serves as a shared substrate from which task-specific workflows are dynamically instantiated. Building on wGraph primitives, we introduce GraphFlow, a system that efficiently integrates workflows into agent serving through two key designs. First, adaptive workflow generation dynamically constructs workflows from wGraph based on task semantics and constraint requirements. Second, workflow state management exploits wGraph structure to efficiently manage Key-Value (KV) caches, reducing redundant computation during agent serving. Extensive experiments across five benchmark datasets show that GraphFlow consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, yielding an average performance improvement of approximately 4.95 percentage points, while achieving an approximately 4$\times$ reduction in memory footprint.

title: LANG: Reinforcement Learning for Multilingual Reasoning with Language-Adaptive Hint Guidance
